Address: Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
ReviewText: I absolutely loved the place. Right from the reservation which was done well by Mrs Sandra to the service everything was done well. We initially booked a garden view but upon request we were switched to sea view which was so thoughtful. The rooms are clean and the buffet had a variety of options with exceptional staff. Rashid and zipporah were exceptional. Apart from that the hotel has a lot of trees which makes it more serene and private and the entertainment sessions at night can’t miss that. || Hotel is very nice, clean, service perfect and all staff very friendly. Ocean is close, beach very nice.you can get drinks and food on the beach. Thwre are different excursions available, lasting few hours or half and whole day. Food in the hotel is very good, traditional but others too || An absolute paradise on Diani Beach! The beachfront views are breathtaking, and the pools are massive and beautifully designed. Our room was luxurious, and the spa treatment was pure bliss. The staff was incredibly welcoming, and the food variety was excellent. Perfect tropical getaway! || I had an amazing stay at Diani Reef Beach Resort & Spa. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always quick to respond to our needs. The service was exceptional throughout our stay. A special thank you to Abaidh for the warm hospitality and professionalism. The beach was beautiful and very clean, making it the perfect place to relax. I highly recommend Diani Reef and look forward to visiting again! || I had a lovely stay here. The staff are super friendly and responsive. The prices are fare and the place is clean and tidy. Its location is ideal and I look forward to coming back here

Address: Ukunda, Diani Beach Road, Kwale, Kenya
ReviewText:
My family’s stay at this hotel was memorable from beginning to end. Food was sweet, accommodations were lovely and resort was really beautiful!

What truly made our stay exceptional, however, was the outstanding service. Lucy at Reception made us feel warmly welcomed, Valentine provided attentive and friendly service in the main restaurant, and Edward, our driver, was gracious, kind, and made every trip to and from the airport and Mombasa a pleasure. I highly recommend a stay here! || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Exceptional Resort in Diani – Architecture, Luxury, Service and Relaxation at Their Finest!

The Swahili Beach Resort in Diani is an outstanding place that combines luxury, beautiful architecture and a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere. We have been thoroughly impressed by the resort and what it has to offer.

One of the absolute highlights is the spectacular pool area. The different pools, the beautiful design and the spacious layout of the entire property create an extraordinary atmosphere. The resort is wonderfully expansive, giving you plenty of room to relax and enjoy your surroundings without feeling crowded.

As an interior designer, I pay particular attention to architecture, materials, spatial design and the way a property is planned and constructed. From that perspective, I find the architecture and overall design of Swahili Beach Resort particularly impressive. The way the buildings, landscaping, pools and communal areas have been brought together is beautiful and thoughtfully executed. The resort has its own distinctive character and manages to combine elegance with the Swahili-inspired architectural style in a very appealing way.

Another highlight is the beach area, especially the bar right by the ocean. Being able to relax on the beach loungers, enjoy a drink and take in the beautiful surroundings makes the experience even more special. The security arrangements throughout the resort and at the beach also contribute to a reassuring and relaxed atmosphere.

The variety of restaurants is another major advantage. Having several dining options within the resort gives guests plenty of choice and makes it easy to enjoy different culinary experiences without having to leave the property.

The service is consistently professional, attentive and well organised. The staff contribute significantly to the overall experience, and you get the feeling that the resort takes its standards seriously. The parking facilities are also excellent, with plenty of space and convenient access.

The rooms, with their own terraces, are another lovely feature, providing a comfortable place to unwind and enjoy some privacy. In the evenings, the resort offers events and entertainment, but the overall atmosphere remains pleasantly relaxed rather than excessively loud or hectic. This balance makes it particularly appealing for guests who want a touch of luxury without sacrificing peace and tranquillity.

What I appreciate most is the overall value for money. You receive a high-quality resort experience, impressive architecture, excellent facilities, professional service and a beautiful setting. Everything comes together to create an experience that feels well worth the price.

For anyone visiting Diani who appreciates beautiful design, excellent pools, a variety of restaurants, a lovely beach setting and professional hospitality, Swahili Beach Resort is definitely worth considering.

A beautiful resort with impressive architecture, excellent facilities and a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || I went their for my birthday. The place is beautiful, great pools and food. Then comes the experience and I am very sad. Their customer handling needs a lot of work. They gave me a room that smelt of mould/moist. Thankfully they gave me another room as I was sneezing and getting sick. Next was my birthday, they did a beautiful cake of course at my cost and after cutting a small piece to eat, I gave them to store to collect in checkout. That's the last time I saw my cake. On checkout, they packed a funny looking cake cutting which of course I couldn't carry home to my children. It saw the next dustbin. The response was reckless. We had asked for diabetic diet on check in, by the time we went. For dinner, we were told that the reception hadnt alignee the chef and they'll prepare our meal from the following day. Kindly improve on customer handling and service. You have a beautiful place || I stayed at Swahili Beach Resort during my solo trip, and I had such a wonderful experience. The location is amazing and very central to everything, while still feeling peaceful and surrounded by beautiful trees and nature.
The rooms were very clean and comfortable, the food was excellent, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming.
It was definitely worth the money and the visit. I left feeling relaxed, refreshed and rejuvenated, which is exactly what I needed from the trip.
I’ll definitely be coming back again! || I’ve visited this resort twice and have had such great experiences!

The staff are friendly, attentive and helpful. There are many food options for dinner and different places to eat on the resort during the day. The rooms are gorgeous and there is a spa on site. There are additional activities to take part in such as group beach walks or light stretching classes. The resort is also a walking distance (across the street) from a shopping centre with a Carrefour. I will be visiting again and I highly recommend Swahili Beach as a place to stay.

Address: Diani Road, South, Coast, Kwale, Kenya
ReviewText:
Great experience using an all-inclusive Day Pass at Diamonds Leisure! Exceptional service and exquisite property. The pools and oceanfront are top-tier, built into the landscape and on the best spot of Diani beach. Great music and lounge areas. Outstanding buffet lunch. Just watch out for the monkeys! lol Had a minor issue and the Guest Services manager, Nancy, was tremendous with helping me out. I’ve visited at least 5 resorts during my stay, and this was by far the best experience and value. Highly recommend! || The resort is very beautiful and well maintained. Lots of swimming pool with bars on it. The package ‘all inclusive’ is a must  to be fully relaxed, both in the bars/restaurant/beach. There are also a lot of activities that the resort offers at different time of the day.
Restaurant is super, we always have eaten different things during our 4 days, the selection was huge and everything was all delicious.

I cannot give 5 star as other resorts I’ve been to since the room was not very cleaned and the forniture was not on par. WiFi in the room was not working and I had to ask the reception twice for stuff I needed (WiFi not fixed though) and the amount of monkeys there are in the resort have gone out of control. Every meal we had, there were monkeys stealing food from some plates. This is not acceptable since for them it was ‘ok’ to have a monkey in your table, above your plate and cutlery. And the cleanings were not up to a 5 star at all also in the restaurant since i’ve never seen a table cloth/sheet to be changed.
Another downside is that it really is as expensive as Europe, so it doesn’t feel like Kenya at all. SPA is very expensive and also the tours that it offers are double the price the beach boys offer you. (But for this you know in advance what you pay)
Anyway, for our staying there we will for sure recommend it to our friends. || We had a wonderful stay at Diamond Leisure Beach & Golf Resort. From the warm welcome by the staff, including the luggage team and the excellent reception staff, our experience was exceptional from start to finish. Special thanks to Philomena for her kindness and professionalism.

Our Bustani room had a fantastic pool view and was clean and comfortable. The beach was beautiful, secure, and well-equipped with sun shades, while the food was excellent throughout our stay.

The resort’s beautiful environment and outstanding service made our visit truly memorable. Highly recommended to anyone visiting Diani! || I had such a pleasant stay. From check-in to the check-out everything was smooth and fantastic. Dennis and Michelle at the reception were exceptionally helpfully and so was Mr. Choyo with the luggage.

The food was delicious, the amenities impeccable. I had a problem with wifi in my room which Dennis and Brian managed to get me a dongle that worked perfectly.

The coral beach bar was absolutely fantastic. The music was good and not noisy allowing one to just chill with a drink or read by the beach.

The rooms were clean and well maintained. I stayed in Oscar 2 and I must say I loved the fact that the products (shampoo,shower gel, lotion and soap) were environmentally friendly. I appreciated the fact that room slippers were on request for sustainability purposes.

Kelvin was extremely helpful with the paddle boarding so was Juma during golfing. I loved that paddle boarding and golfing were complimentary.

I had such a tranquil solo stay. I will definitely be back. || I have no words to describe how beautiful, luxurious this location is.
Thank you for the eucalyptus  aroma which opened up my nostrils!
The "Mvua" / Rain Spa Aroma: The prominent eucalyptus, minty, and fresh herbal aroma experienced throughout the guest rooms and common areas is tied directly to their on-site wellness branding (Mvua African Rain Spa). Housekeeping uses these diluted natural oils in diffusers, tile-mopping water, and linen mists to naturally purify the air and provide antimicrobial surface care.

How fabulous to have my delicious lunch watching the children play on the beach and at the pool and see the waves crashing on the sand.
Come here and let the lovely Musembi serve you with a smile! I thoroughly recommend the Goats Stew. Order from the menu or have the buffet selection.
Both indoor and outdoor dining under the palm or by the pool. || Thank you for hosting us.
The resort is perfect for family vacations. So central that you can walk to get groceries, Gelato and loads of café / restaurants. || Wonderful Family Stay at Coral Beach Resort, Diani Beach, Kenya

My family—two adults and two children—stayed at Coral Beach Resort in beautiful Diani Beach, Kenya, from December 19th to 22nd, 2025. It was a fantastic short holiday getaway during the festive season. We chose one of their budget-friendly cottages, which was perfect for us: spacious, cozy, and equipped with a kitchen, making it feel like a home away from home without any extravagance.
The resort is right on the stunning white sands of Diani Beach, with direct access to the turquoise Indian Ocean waters. The kids had an absolute blast splashing in the waves, building sandcastles, and enjoying the year-round outdoor pool surrounded by lush gardens. Even though December brought some breezy weather, the beach and pool areas were idyllic and relaxing.
We loved the on-site restaurant, which served delicious international and local Kenyan cuisines—convenient for quick meals without venturing far. Breakfasts there were a highlight, with fresh options that kept everyone happy.
The location couldn't be better: just a short walk to the Diani shopping center, banks, and plenty of other restaurants for variety. We easily popped out for some shopping and dinners, all while keeping things easy with the little ones.
Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The staff were warm and welcoming, the atmosphere peaceful and family-friendly, and it offered excellent value for a beach holiday in Kenya. Highly recommend Coral Beach Resort to families seeking an affordable, relaxing escape on one of the world's most beautiful beaches—we'd love to return! || I recently stayed at the Coral Resort for a four-night weekend getaway, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I arrived, the staff greeted me warmly and made the check-in process seamless and efficient.
The room was spacious, elegantly furnished, and spotlessly clean. I particularly appreciated the comfortable king-sized bed and the stunning lake view from the balcony, which made mornings truly refreshing. The bathroom was modern and well-stocked with quality toiletries.
The staff were consistently friendly, professional, and eager to assist with any requests. The overall atmosphere of the hotel was calm and inviting, making it a perfect retreat from the busy city life. || The cottage is run down, the rooms are very stuffy and mouldy. The kitchen is understocked and infested with dudua. The outside around the cottage is unkept and dirty.
Were ushered in a cottage that was not prepared for our arrival .
Sorry cannot recommend.
Then it rained and the rooms flooded, the roof was leaking ..wueh... pure pain.

Address: Plot LR 13430, Diani Beach Road Diani, Ukunda, Kenya
ReviewText:
I previously reviewed this resort and gave it a 1 star. I am now revising my review as the service once we spoke to the guest relations manager improved significantly.

Sophia, one of the servers in the buffet, is lovely. And Chef Moses went out of his way to accommodate our needs. Mercie in guest relations was amazing, and pulled out all of the stops (cake for our honeymoon, door arch decorations, decor in our room, room service wine in the evening and lattes in the morning) to make our stay extra special.

Yes, there is noise late into the evening from various events, but this is not something the hotel can control. Everything within their control and ability to change was fantastic. || Enjoyed my 2 night stay at southern palms. The hotel amenities were pretty good. The staff were excellent and always greeted you with a smile and a warm welcome. Guest relations manager was superb and very attentive to my needs. All the food at this place was halal except the obvious pork dishes which were kept to one side. The main buffet resteraunt was decent with plenty of options meaning that there was something for every palate.  I would however steer clear of the braziliaj style bbq resteraunt that you have to reserve. It was always empty and this is enough of a sign as to its popularity. I upgraded my room from a normal room to a ocean front deluxe meaning that I could open the room door and stroll straight out onto the beach. This upgrade made the entire trip and was definitely worth it, albeit a little expensive. I would definitely recommend the excursion to Wasini island that includes snorkeling with dolphins - an amazing day trip. || The hotel has a really lovely stretch of beach. The sea is beautiful— at least when there are no seaweed.

we were put in a room (I think it was 282) right next to the housekeeping storage area, so we were exposed to all the smells and noise coming from there. Generally, that corner—near the mosque and the laundry room—just smelled odd and was noisy...

After complaining for three days, we were finally moved to a different room (270); there were no more smells or noise, but then there was an issue with the door lock, which would only accept one specific key card... we tried at least seven others from reception with no success, after 5 days we gave up...
On top of that, the faucets were completely rusted...(see pics)
How can they offer a room like that ?
Completely unhygienic...

The food was okay, even though it was heavily Indian-style.
They should probably specify on the website that it is a hotel with a strong Indian focus. That wasn't a problem for me, as I enjoy the cuisine, but it might not be clear to others.

Given that you're in a malaria-prone region, I would have expected a bit more to be done about it—for example, setting up mosquito coils in the common areas in the evening or ensuring there is no stagnant water near the living areas

But when—after nearly two weeks of all-inclusive at the hotel—I can't even get a drink right after checking out (except for one bottle of water), then... Well, it’s best to stock up on enough drinks before checking out to tide you over for the 15–30 minutes before departure, if you need them. || We had such a lovely stay at Southern Palms Beach Resort! The service was really top-notch, and honestly, every staff member we interacted with was so warm, friendly, and welcoming.

A special shout-out to Elphas, who welcomed us so warmly and made our stay even more comfortable. He was always around and ready to assist whenever we needed anything, and we really appreciated how thoughtful and attentive he was.

And the ambience? Absolutely to die for! 😍 The whole place is beautiful, peaceful, and has such a nice relaxed vibe. We genuinely enjoyed every moment of our stay and would definitely come back again. ❤️ || We recently stayed here and had booked an ocean view room on the ground floor. The view was completely blocked by the pool beds. In the evenings, hotel entertainment happens near pool area which is very near to the room.  It can even last till midnight! The music was so loud we couldn't even sleep and felt we were in a night club.We requested them to atleast lower down the volume which they did not. There was even a wedding happening. But surprisingly wedding noise didn’t disturb us much and finished on time. But hotel entertainment was so loud and disturbing.  Basically, our view was blocked and we couldn't even get good sleep and couldnt even enjoy the sound of the ocean at night. Food is amazing. Staff is good. I suggest not to book ocean view rooms in this hotel if you have come to rest and if you mind loud music. It is better to book far away rooms.

Address: Off Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
ReviewText:
Spent a few days at this gorgeous little hotel. Had the executive suite with private pool. Unobtrusive staff and magical balmy days and nights made for such wonderful downtime ❤️ No request was too small.
Would love to spend more time here 😫, next time.!
The bar and DJ's booth by the main pool could see more action with some evening specials but otherwise perfect accommodations away from the crowds.
Service was truly top notch all around from our luggage being whisked away to our rooms to the welcome drinks.
Asanteni sana , I will be back ❤️ || I read a review saying it looks better in real life and I can honestly agree. Beautiful hotel, attentive staff, and great facilities. I travelled solo here and was the perfect boutique hotel. Delicious seafood, fresh and great value for money. Felt safe the whole time. A security guard always at the door to welcome you. The room was spacious and comfortable, beautiful art work on the walls. Everything you want from a hotel.

The location of the hotel is relatively close to everything eg. Beach and shopping centre. However at night the off road is pitch black and would recommend transport going down. I never had any issues walking down there but as a heads up when staying here, it is off road.
Otherwise there is 24/7 security and cameras once approaching the property || We had a wonderful time here. The rooms were very clean, the staff was incredibly kind and accommodating. The perfect serene stay while in Diani || While on booking it is stated that they do free airport shuttle, they charged 11 dollars for it. That is exactly 10 times what it is compared to Uber prices. We brought up the issue, there was no good will. When given the chance to make it right, they chose not to exercise that and said this is how it is. So the response below does not reflect the experience me and my partner had. We will not be returning. || Friendly attentive staff. Good dine in options. Not much entertainment at the hotel. Solid 20min walk to the beach.

Address: Jacaranda Indian Ocean Beach Resort Diani, Diani Beach Road, Diani, Kenya
ReviewText:
An exceptional hotel and exceptional service
We had a wonderful stay at Jacaranda Indian Ocean Beach Resort.
The hotel is beautiful, the service is excellent, and the staff are incredibly attentive.
But I would especially like to thank the manager who went above and beyond for us this morning. Due to an unexpected flight schedule change, I was at serious risk of missing my international flight from Nairobi. I explained the situation to him, and within just five minutes, he had taken the matter in hand and found a solution for us.
He personally arranged a private transfer to Nairobi and made sure to find us an experienced and reliable driver who knew the road perfectly. He immediately understood the urgency of our situation and acted incredibly quickly and efficiently. Thanks to him, we had a real chance of making our flight.
This is what exceptional hospitality looks like: listening, understanding and taking action when a guest really needs help.
A huge thank you to the entire Jacaranda team, and especially to this gentleman for his kindness, professionalism and efficiency. We will remember this gesture for a long time. ❤️
Highly recommended! 🌴🇰🇪✈️ || Unfortunately I had a horrible experience with the male receptionist/manager who was there on 14th October morning, about charges of Ksh 5000 for my family member visiting my room 1hr before check out, no mention of this amount in the contract/agreement signed. Very poor customer service, no inclination to find a common ground or solution, even threatening to call security on me.
Everything else was great, but this customer service experience negated that. || One of the most beautiful and loved places I've ever been.
Thanks to all who are responsible for feeling save like Grandol, a polite young security , the friendly reception team, the gardeners, espacially one who gave me flowers and a fresh coconut to my table at my extraordinary hut.
Best breakfast with fresh and delicious fruits and Suaheli specials.
It is a paradise, I want to come agsin with my family. I recommend this resort!!!! || Ambient spacious space with the perfect sea view with so many amazing tourist destinations close by. Catching sunrise by the ocean and sunsets at Kongo River on the opposite side of the beach was quite the highlight. Staying here felt like a dream you don’t want to end.

The staff were very friendly, welcoming and professional. Highly recommended. || We stayed here for three nights and I should say a big thanks to Animation Team, their DJ Christopher and Big John who has entertained us with beach volleyball games, dance nights, traditional dances and karaoke 👌

The rooms and their equipment are quite old, and poor condition. Towels, sheets and seat mattresses need to be replaced. Shampoo and body washes are really low in quality.

Last thing, it’s ridiculous that you have to pay for water in the hotel!

Address: Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
ReviewText:
We had a fantastic stay at Tombo House! The location is back from the beach but is in a beautiful forest, and easy to either walk to the beach or get an uber / tuk tuk. The hotel is extremely well maintained and the rooms were very clean and comfortable. We ate in the restaurant a couple of times and enjoyed the food, and the breakfast also had a wide range of options on offer. Staff were friendly and helpful and the pool was also lovely! We wish we could have stayed longer. || Staff saved this from a 2-star review!
I was honestly planning to leave a 2 or 3-star review, but the staff here was so phenomenal that I am bumping this up to 4 stars solely out of respect for their hard work.

The Pros
The Staff: Absolutely incredible. They are so welcoming, warm, and attentive. They truly do their best to make you feel comfortable.

The Rooms: The rooms are very large and spacious.

The Balcony: The natural breeze on the balcony creates a lovely, deeply relaxed atmosphere. And the view over Kaya forest is just amazing!

The Cons:
Unfortunately, the negatives are numerous and significantly impacted our comfort

Salty Shower Water: The water in all the showers is extremely salty. My girlfriend is a local and mentioned this can happen in the area, but the majority of guests here are foreign tourists who are definitely not used to showering in salt water. It makes it impossible to feel clean.

Hidden A/C Fees: I booked two rooms through Booking.com with breakfast included. Upon arrival, I was hit with a surprise fee of $15 USD per day, per room, just to turn on the air conditioning. This should be transparently included in the booking price.

Strict Outside Food Policy: They heavily restrict outside food. While major resorts do this, Tombo House is a small hotel and does not have a wide enough food selection to justify trapping guests into eating only from their limited menu.

Charcoal Smoke: There is a persistent smoke in the air, which I believe comes from charcoal burning, that becomes completely unbearable at times.

Smoking Area Location: The designated smoking area is located way too close to the restaurant and bar, forcing non-smokers to breathe it in while trying to eat.

The team working here is top-tier, but management needs to address these basic hospitality issues, especially regarding hidden fees and water quality. || Amazing place with amazing views at a very affordable price point! Its still day 1 of my vacation i will update this on my last day here.
Breakfast for the past 2 days has been amazing with a lot of warm and cold selections. My room was cleaned every day in a timely manner. I got to enjoy the pool during the day and night time. The pool happens to be open for 24hrs which is a plus and new for me as I have never stayed in a place where the pool open past sun down! The staff are super friendly and helpful. || Efficient Hotel – Lacks Charm, Value, and Authenticity

First, the positives: the hotel is clean, secluded, and quiet, with a strong and attentive staff. The rooms are spacious, clean, and comfortable, though very minimalistic. The food is decent but overpriced.

That said, the overall experience lacks charm and value. The location is off the main path, with poor road access, and I found myself taking long Uber rides just to reach the beach or basic points of interest. Power outages were frequent, disrupting Wi-Fi, and the property is missing several key amenities I would expect at this price point.

Most concerning was misleading information in the listing. The hotel was advertised as having air conditioning, which it did not—there was an additional $15/day charge on top of an already ~$100/night rate. The “fitness facilities” were simply a room with yoga mats and a couple of light weights.

The response from ownership was equally disappointing. Rather than acknowledging the inaccuracies, they deflected responsibility and refused to allow me to shorten my stay or offer any compensation, despite additional costs I incurred for gym access and transportation.

There were also infrastructure concerns. The water is not filtered (showers are salty), and several guests, including myself, became ill after eating breakfast on-site over a two-day period.

For those visiting Diani, I would suggest either spending slightly more for a full-service resort with proper amenities or opting for a simpler $40–$60 room in a better location and using the savings for activities.

Ultimately, this property feels overpriced, poorly represented, and focused more on maximizing revenue than delivering a quality guest experience. || We had a superb experience at Tombow House. The food was absolutely delicious, being prepared by one of the owners who is an amazing chef. The owners were very warm, and the whole staff was truly welcoming and attentive.

The room was really amazing, with a very unique setting, and the bed was extremely comfortable. A big highlight is the 24-hour pool - such a great advantage that few places offer.

Tombow House will surprise you in the best possible way - highly recommended.

I spent 3 nights/4 days at The Maji during a solo trip to Diani in June, and it was exactly the relaxing escape I was looking for. The hotel has an incredibly chill, peaceful vibe that really helped me unplug and unwind.

What truly made the experience special was the staff. Everyone was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring throughout my stay. A special thank you to Zipporah (Manager), Risper (Guest Relations), Nusra, Eresmus, Caroline, Violet, and the entire cleaning crew for making me feel so welcome and well taken care of.

The location is fantastic, right on an amazing stretch of beach, and the food was consistently excellent. Whether relaxing by the ocean, enjoying meals, or simply soaking in the atmosphere, everything about the experience felt thoughtful and effortless.

Highly recommend The Maji for anyone looking for a peaceful and memorable stay in Diani — especially solo travelers looking to recharge. || Our first stay at The Maji Boutique Hotel was unforgettable. The warmth, intention, and luxury here go far beyond what any review can capture. From the seamless airport pick‑up to the heartfelt welcome, every detail was thoughtful and beautifully done.

The meals were generous and delicious, the rooms spotless and serene, and the service truly exceptional. Evelyn, Zippy, Moraa, and Farida cared for us with such genuine kindness. And a special thank‑you to Simon, whose attentiveness made our stay feel like home.

The Maji didn’t just host us — it held us gently. We left with full hearts and can’t wait to return. || If you’re looking for the perfect boutique hotel on the Kenyan coast, look no further than The Maji — an absolute gem that delivers on every promise. We were blown away from the moment we arrived. Our ocean view was simply jaw-dropping and falling asleep to the sound of the Indian Ocean waves was an experience in itself. The food was delicious and there was such a variety.

Special shout out to Simon, our server, who was an absolute star. He made me tea every morning with different spices he thought I would like. Truly the best! || What a lovely stay at the Maji!  So peaceful, so relaxing, with impeccable service, the best we’ve found in all of Kenya by far!  Relaxing in the beach loungers overlooking the ocean was heavenly. The food was delicious, with thoughtful and creative presentation. They made everything extra special for Valentines weekend, going above and beyond to create a romantic atmosphere.  Our ocean view suite was lovely, comfortable bed and pillows!  The water cooler in the room was a very nice amenity to have with the hot Diani weather! The housekeeping service was excellent, the wait staff clearly took pride in their service, and the manager Zipporah made sure the guests are well taken care of.  It was clear this is a well trained set of staff who make you feel right at home. When our flight was cancelled they were so helpful in welcoming us for an additional evening.  Having traveled a lot all over the world, we know a good establishment when we stay in one and the Maji is definitely top notch! || Super place, super location and super staff. Food was good and plentiful. The room was spacious and tidy. The whole resort is peaceful, and relaxing. The only downside is the gym which really needs new equipment and shouldnt be promoted as it is. The whole staff from zippy, to Daniel, to Evelyn to Jackson were great … and many more we forgot too. Thank you

Address: Diani, Diani Beach Road, Diani Beach, Kenya
ReviewText:
I loved it there. The service is nice and the staff are helpful and respectful.
The food is good too. However I didnt like their fries. But their pizza??? 10/10
The views at the beach? 10/10 too.
I sat by the beach a couple of times, so worth it.
This place didnt disappoint.
Their pool is also so big and well maintained.
The location is great. I even walked to the Carrefour junction one time about 5200 steps from the hotel.
It was a great experience. || This is a great place to go with a big group, especially with kids. The villas are spacious and fitted with AC and fans in all the rooms and are all ensuite. Friendly staff though check in was delayed quite a bit. It is beach front so you can choose between lounging at the pool or the beach. || We stayed in Bahari beach villas 2 nights in the end of May 2026. Location is very nice, next to the beach, you have beach view and they have pools (but could have been much cleaner - there was no proper dress code for the pool, people kept using their normal outfits in the pool while swimming which was not something we excepted). they have resto-bar set up. Breakfast was included in our stay, but it was not great. Manageable.

We stayed in a shared villa, with a kitchen facility, but it could have been much cleaner, the other tourists who stayed at the villa cooked and left all the cooking waste in the sink, it was not clean at all. The management dint clean it for hours.

There was no WiFi in the room or the lobby, in spite of them mentioning there is 24/7 WiFi facility. Also, there was no power in the property during daytime for more than 4-5 hours, we raised the issue, but still had to sit at the room without power. They have a generator set up, but I believe it dint work or switched on. Toilet lights were really dim. Could have been improved. || They get one star for setting up a stage at the bar for the weekend, ignoring hotel guests and throwing a party from Friday to Sunday. Imagine not sleeping for two nights because music plays until 5:00 a.m. There's no hotel silence. I don't recommend it and I 100% advise against it. || We had booked a deluxe villa. I can’t wait to return! ❤️ || We chose Leopard Beach Resort expecting a luxury experience, especially after paying a premium price for a two-bedroom pool villa. Unfortunately, our stay fell far short of expectations.

After arriving early in the morning following an overnight flight, we were told our rooms were not ready and were asked to wait for coffee. Since we had booked all-inclusive, we assumed breakfast would be included, but were told it only starts after check-in and that the missed breakfast would be replaced by breakfast on departure day. In reality, when we left at 7 a.m., there was almost nothing available apart from coffee and toast.

The biggest disappointment was the villa itself. There was a strong smell of sewage as soon as we entered. The furniture was worn, curtains and chairs were stained, the pool pump was broken, there was visible mould on the bedroom walls, and paint was peeling in several areas. A staff path through the garden also removed any sense of privacy. None of this is acceptable in accommodation sold at premium prices.

To her credit, Rosie, the Head of Housekeeping, was excellent and personally helped move us to another villa. We are very grateful for her professionalism and care. We also want to mention Juma, our housekeeper, who went out of his way every day to make us comfortable.

The main pool was also disappointing. When we asked for towels, we were given damp, stained towels that appeared to have been reused from sun loungers. We did not feel comfortable using the pool area again.

The restaurant service was also below standard. Drink orders were taken after we were seated, but many times we had to reorder more than once as we were forgotten about. On several evenings there were no clean plates or even small spoons available, and wine was repeatedly served in sparkling wine glasses rather than proper wine glasses.

What made this especially frustrating is that the staff themselves were wonderful. Every employee we met was friendly, hardworking and genuinely tried their best. The problems seem to come from poor maintenance, lack of investment and weak management rather than the staff.

After being moved, the second villa which had 3 bedrooms was cleaner and better kept, although the beds were still old and uncomfortable. Even so, it was a clear improvement over the first villa.

As someone with over 30 years of hotel management experience, I did not write this lightly. Leopard Beach Resort has a beautiful location and excellent people, but it is living on its past reputation. ReviewText:
A Wonderful Beachfront Experience at Cocoa Boutique Hotel
I recently stayed at Cocoa Boutique Hotel in Mombasa for three nights with my wife, and honestly, the experience was wonderful. From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and well taken care of.
Before coming to the hotel, I had been communicating with Tom through Instagram. He was very friendly, helpful, and professional, and we agreed that everything would be well taken care of when we arrived. True to his word, when we got to the hotel, I found Tom at the reception, and he received us warmly. Throughout our stay, he remained very helpful and made sure everything was comfortable for both my wife and me.
One of the things I loved most about the hotel was its beachfront location and the beautiful ocean view. Waking up and being able to enjoy the view of the ocean really made the stay special. The hotel also has a good swimming pool, which added to the relaxing experience. The atmosphere is peaceful, relaxing, and perfect for anyone looking to escape and enjoy some time by the coast.
Another advantage is the hotel's convenient location. It is close to Nyali Centre, Mamba Village, and Wild Waters, making it easy to go shopping, explore the area, or simply find places to enjoy yourself without travelling too far.
Overall, we really enjoyed our three-night stay, and I would definitely recommend Cocoa Boutique Hotel to anyone visiting Mombasa, especially couples looking for a relaxing beachfront experience.
The only area I feel the hotel could improve on is some of the renovations and general upgrading of a few facilities. With a little more attention in that area, the hotel could make an already great experience even better.

A big thank you to Tom and the entire team for making our stay memorable. We would definitely consider coming back! || Biggest cons. The hotel is run down, the services are terrible. Our balcony flooded, hot water wouldn’t work. Terrible food. Refused to refund our money for the rest of the nights but we left anyway. Do NOT book. Beware! || Great boutique hotel with beautiful views and spacious rooms. Guests should expect an older style, as the hotel has a classic boutique feel, so some furniture and bathrooms may be dated.

A special thank you to Olga for her help and excellent service during my stay. || In short.... DO NOT PAY TO STAY HERE.

Address: Ras Kitau Bay - Manda Island Lamu Archipelago, Kenya
ReviewText:
Majlis, you owe me absolutely NOTHING! 😅 If anything, I owe you a standing ovation because this place has surpassed my expectations in ways I am still struggling to put into words. Beautiful is an understatement. Majlis is an experience, and every little detail seems to conspire to make you fall in love with it.

Let us start with the arrival. The panoramic views are breathtaking, offering an introduction to the kind of beauty that awaits you. The attendants were incredibly helpful, and the reception service was prompt, warm, and welcoming. From the very beginning, you get the sense that hospitality here is not simply a service but something the team genuinely takes pride in.

The pool area? Absolutely magnificent. The juxtaposition of the inviting pool against the darker, expansive ocean creates a striking visual that is difficult to do justice to in photographs. The pool attendants were personable, attentive, and prompt, making it easy to settle into the moment. The passion freeze, recommended during my visit, was an absolute favourite. And the mint juice alongside the pizza prosciutto, which the attendant thoughtfully recommended, was another highlight. Sometimes, the best discoveries happen when you trust the people who know their menu!

For anyone who enjoys an active holiday, the Majlis Sports Centre deserves special recognition. My 40 km cycling adventure around Manda Island, accompanied by a guide, was one for the books. Captain Simba, my guide, made the experience particularly memorable. What a way to explore the island! It was the perfect combination of adventure, beautiful scenery, and the satisfaction of discovering a place under your own steam.

And then there are the sunsets. Oh, the sunsets! Majlis has a distinct aesthetic at that magical hour, with the pool, the ocean, and the changing colours of the sky coming together in a way that feels almost unreal. There is something about watching the sun descend over the water here that makes you want to put your phone down, take a deep breath, and simply exist in the moment.

Majlis, thank you for exceeding expectations. Five stars feel insufficient. Ten stars, if they were available!I left with beautiful memories, a happy heart, and absolutely no complaints. || Overpriced and Disappointing – Poor Value for Money
My experience at The Majlis was, unfortunately, disappointing, particularly given the considerable cost of our stay.
I visited with my partner and two other couples to celebrate a 25th wedding anniversary. Two couples travelled from England, while my partner and I travelled from Ghana. We stayed for four nights and five days on a half-board basis, with my partner and I occupying a Junior Suite.
While the breakfast offering was sufficient, the lunch and dinner menus left much to be desired. The choices were surprisingly limited for an establishment positioning itself at this price point. Worse still, I found several of the meals excessively salty and generally underwhelming.
Despite being on a half-board package, we naturally paid separately for our poolside lunches and certain extras at dinner. However, nothing prepared me for the astonishing USD 767 bill presented at checkout. I was genuinely shocked, particularly when I considered the limited menu options and disappointing quality of the food.
To be fair, the staff were welcoming, attentive and professional, and the service was generally good. However, good service alone cannot justify what I consider to be excessive pricing.
Having travelled extensively and experienced numerous luxury hotels and resorts, I appreciate quality hospitality and am quite prepared to pay a premium when the experience warrants it. Unfortunately, The Majlis fell well short of delivering value commensurate with its prices.
My overall assessment: good staff and service, but seriously overpriced, with an underwhelming dining experience. Sadly, not worth the money spent. || Spent a half day here. Went for swimming and lunch. It's 2800 to access the property, 2000 to rent a towel . It's a truly cool place. The calamari was the best I have had anywhere. It was the best meal I had on my seven days stay at shela, Lamu. The service is top notch. The sights and spaces to eat and chill are quite good. I think 2800 is a bit on the high side since it is not redeemable but well it's a good place. || The Majlis Hotel in Lamu is a true paradise. From the moment we arrived, we loved the peaceful atmosphere, beautiful surroundings, and stunning ocean views. It is the perfect place to relax.

The staff were amazing, always friendly, helpful, and attentive. A special mention to Hamiti and his team, who made our stay even more special. They were incredibly kind, welcoming, and always made sure everything was perfect. Their attention to detail and warm hospitality made us feel at home.

We had an unforgettable stay at The Majlis and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a beautiful, peaceful place with excellent service. || My sister and I had a wonderful 3 night stay at The Majlis from the 10th of August. The experience from the beginning was amazing and interesting; from the airport luggage pickup in a cart, the boat ride to the hotel and a lovely chat with simeon, the warm welcome with the staff singing for us, the front office smiles and kindness...the list is endless.
We enjoyed Kayaking, tubing, a visit to lamu town and the sunset dhow cruise our highlight.
I will always remember the outstanding poolside service of waiter Mzungu, manager Hamisi's great professionalism, captain Simbas's dedication during kayaking and waitress Fatma for her attentiveness. They ingrained our beautiful memories of The Majlis. We hope to come back soon for another relaxed and fun filled holiday.

Staying at Shela Bliss was an absolute delight! The place is impeccably clean, and the level of comfort is unparalleled. The beds are incredibly cozy, ensuring a restful sleep like no other. The breakfasts are a feast for the senses, with a variety of delicious choices that cater to every palate. The views from the rooftop terrace are simply breathtaking, offering an amazing panorama of the ocean, the charming village, and the sand dunes in the background. Plus, there's a dedicated desk area for digital nomads or workaholics, complete with reliable Wi-Fi, so you can stay productive while enjoying the stunning sea views. Shela Bliss truly embodies tranquil luxury, making it the perfect getaway for anyone seeking a bit of indulgence. Highly recommended!

A. Tim ||

We loved the salt water pool and the quiet ambience around the pool. Definitely coming back here again! || We had a wonderful stay at Banana House. The food, pool and facilities were all fantastic and we especially loved our massages and the Swahili feast. The staff are all extremely friendly. Masha and Charles in particular looked after us with great care and attention. We would love to come back! || Absolutely loved my stay at Banana House! The location is perfect, close to everything while still being in a peaceful and quiet neighborhood. I stayed in the spa cottage, and Sifa truly made my stay. His kindness, attention to detail, and warm hospitality made the experience even more special.

The hotel is also well known for its yoga classes. Unfortunately, I didn’t get a chance to join one this time, but that’s definitely on my list for my next visit.

Highly recommended! || Our stay at Banana House in Lamu was truly unforgettable. It felt less like a hotel and more like a beautiful home where you instantly feel welcomed and at peace.

We came for a girls’ trip to reconnect after years of friendship and to recharge before returning to our busy lives. Banana House was the perfect setting for this special break—calm, relaxing, and full of charm.

A special thank you to the incredible team, especially Charles, who took exceptional care of us throughout our stay. Nothing was ever too much trouble, and his kindness, professionalism, and attention to detail made all the difference. We’d also like to thank Tizo, who looked after us so thoughtfully in the evenings Thanks for thé swahili dinner amazing experience .

Thank you all for creating such a warm and memorable experience. We leave with beautiful memories and would gladly return. Highly recommended! || I really wanted to like this place. The staff were friendly and warm. But honestly the value for price was just not there.

Banana House is definitely cute and full of character, with rustic rooms. However, for the price, I honestly expected much better value, especially considering there are cheaper hotels nearby that seem to offer a more comfortable and polished experience.

The rooms themselves were fine, but guests are asked to remove their shoes at the door while the foot washing stations are placed in awkward locations instead of near covered areas. With the rain, it ended up being impossible not to track dirt back into the room anyway, so the setup didn’t really make sense in all and just annoyed us.

One of the biggest frustrations was the cleanliness and upkeep of the common areas. Staff were very slow to clear breakfast and lunch dishes, especially around the pool area. Food and plates often sat there for hours, attracting flies and making the space unpleasant to relax in.

The old fashioned locks were also more annoying than charming. Having to carry around a padlock felt impractical, and more importantly, the fact that someone could potentially lock you inside your room is a serious fire safety concern. Rustic style is nice, but not when it compromises basic safety. My friend actually accidently locked me the room early in the morning.

Bed did not have blankets, only sheets. I was cold at night.

It was also strange that no drinking water was provided, especially at this price point. The pool area itself also did not feel particularly clean or well maintained. It was small and the rain and the lack of clearing food from the pool area made it unpleasant. This also limited the places we could sit and relax or read. There was a table outside our room, which was nice for breakfast, but in the evening or during the rain it was not idea. It was also pretty loud, we could hear the staff from our room early in the morning.

Additionally, I was shocked they did not have umbrellas for the clients. That was quite disappointing. We paid over $150 a night, i would expect a bottle of water and an umbrella.

Overall, Banana House has charm and personality, with kind staff but the experience didn’t match the cost. It feels more focused on aesthetic rustic, wellness  vibes than comfort, practicality, or value for money.

The views are 1000/10 they are beautiful it’s next to the ocean and you get a good breeze at that on top of that majlis is just across and a few minute boat ride can take you there for dinner
However I feel they fell short on housekeeping and cleanses. The pillow cases had sweat line stains and that was for all rooms.
The bathrooms had a bad smell and the water too smelt like sewege it was hard taking a shower. It was worse in the ground floor room. It was more like drainage smell.
The seats in the living area were brown but you could see a line of dirt stain .

The staff were all so courteous, helpful, happy, and kind. Their energies and vibes were super.

Forodhani is a beach house with an intentionally-cultivated rustic feel. You'd feel like you were in a lavish period drama.

The chef was outstanding. Meal times, snack times, barbecue, all divine!
Then there was this adorable staff member named Felix; he was a real darling.

No concept was impossible for them to actualise.

There was a projector for movie night, and Bluetooth speaker for dance music, or even yoga.

Name it, they made it happen.

The pool, though narrow, was clean and hygienic.

They turned down our room, sprayed undetectable insecticide, and arranged the mosquito nets every evening.

There was a rooftop giving such lovely views.
The view out of my bedroom window was enviable.

I didn't want to leave! || My stay at Forodhani is a memory I've chosen to fondly carry around with me for the rest of my life. I had dreamt, imagined and anticipated of what it would be like to stay in a place I had admired in only pictures. I don't think anything could have prepared me for the wonderful experience that awaited me including the countless pictures I'd saved of this beautiful property. Forodhani for me is beyond a place, it's a feeling of warmth , joy and beauty that nothing can quite describe until you experience it for yourself. Isabelle was so helpful and kind and provided clarity on everything I needed. The airport transfers were well organized and always on time. The activities that followed were always arranged with care. Despite staying alone at the house I never felt awkward or out of place, the staff were excellent at anticipating my needs while giving me room to be myself. Everywhere I turned I was met with beautiful views and you could tell everything about the house was thoughtfully done. Whether I was writing at the desk in my room or simply enjoying a shower , I always enjoyed a beautiful views of the ocean. The meals that Chef Silas prepared were always delicious and my table was always set right next to the pool with a wonderful view of the ocean. It was a nice change of pace in my life to truly slow down , enjoy the wonderful coffee table books in the house and experience such kindness among everyone I encountered.
Thank you to the entire team at Forodhani for creating such a wonderful experience for my first time in Lamu. Shela is a place I will always hold in high regard because of you ♡

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An unforgettable week at Dhow House!

We had the most amazing week at Dhow House in Lamu. What a beautiful property and such a special place to spend a holiday!

The house is absolutely stunning, with beautiful gardens, a lovely pool, amazing architecture and plenty of space to relax. Every corner of the property is beautiful.

But what really made our stay so special was the staff. Honestly, every single one of them was amazing. So friendly, kind, helpful and always smiling. They really looked after us and made us feel at home.

And the food! Oh my God, absolutely delicious! We have eaten at a lot of the best five-star restaurants in London, and I can honestly say the food here was even better. Every meal was fantastic!

A huge thank you to Katy and the whole team for such a wonderful experience. We enjoyed every minute of our stay and couldn’t have asked for more.

I would definitely recommend Dhow House to anyone visiting Lamu or Kenya. It’s not just a beautiful place to stay; it’s the whole experience that makes it so special. Absolutely worth a visit, and we would love to come back! 💝 || Dhow House is an absolutely stunning villa right on the beach in Lamu, offering a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and tranquillity. From the moment you arrive, you’re welcomed into a peaceful paradise with breathtaking ocean views and an incredible atmosphere.

The villa itself is beautifully designed, spacious, and immaculately maintained. The highlight for me was the amazing pool, ideal for cooling off while enjoying the serene surroundings. The private cook was exceptional, creating meals that were nothing short of London fine-dining standards – fresh, flavourful, and expertly prepared.

If you’re looking for a peaceful getaway where you can fully unwind, Dhow House is the perfect spot. A true hidden gem in Lamu, and I can’t wait to return! Highly recommended. || Dhow House is spectacular oasis of tranquility, with its huge tendered tropical gardens right on the beach and close to Shela. There are 8-10 well trained staff who fuss over your every need including a hugely talented and creative chef 'Baraka' who is 5-star if not Michelin standard. Breakfast was included and the nice thing was flexibility on timing and choice. Lunch and dinners is served on a grand dining table next to the sunken lounge. boat and organised an amazing trip to remote beach and reef for snorkeling. I also enjoyed the massage and  yoga sessions in the turrets studio overlooking the sea.

We had an amazing stay at Beytul! The ambience was peaceful, the ocean breeze refreshing, and the views were absolutely breathtaking.
A special thank you to David and Jivanjee for your outstanding hospitality and making our trip so smooth and memorable.
We highly recommend Beytul and look forward to visiting again. May God bless the entire team! || It's an okay apartment. We were a group of 10. The staff is really friendly and made up for everything else. It is not clean at all,  they try and clean but I feel the place can be taken cared of better. It's really beautiful inside, just cleanliness. The views from the top apartment are spectacular. So it is what you pay. Did I say the staff is friendly? Very. We ran out of water because maybe there was alot of us and we showered twice a day. Oh there's no hot water, well we didn't have but it actually didn't matter because the Island is so hot, you appreciate a cold shower. There's low tide and high tide. The boat can pick you up from the house during high tide and you have to walk about a minute to catch the boat at low tide. Only bring flops you really don't need sneakers when here because you'll either walk barefooted like the locals or in your flops. Easy to access town, a short walk will get you there. The boat can get you around. Really beautiful place Lamu and out hosts were friendly. The breakfast was  also delicious, pastries and fruits. || Had a wonderful stay at this hotel! ReviewText: I loved my stay at Shiban House. I stayed about 8 days in total, both alone in a small room and then with a friend in the top room. Whether you decide to get lost in Lamu town or choose to stay in at the poolside and soak it all in, Tulia House invites you to slow down. Proper pole pole living.

A place to truly unwind. || This island house is a dream! The views are stunning, and the house is beautifully designed and well-equipped. Highly recommend for a peaceful getaway! || What an absolute dream experience! The house is amazing, beautifully styled, well-designed and very user-friendly. I had an incredible stay at Tulia House Lamu. One of the things that stood out the most was the stunning décor  a beautiful fusion of modern design with rich Kenyan cultural elements. Every corner of the space feels thoughtfully curated, from the earthy tones and handcrafted details to the contemporary furniture that adds a clean stylish touch.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting with a unique character that makes you feel both at home and deeply connected to Lamu’s charm and heritage. It’s clear that a lot of care went into making the space not just beautiful but meaningful.

The staff were amazing, friendly, professional and always ready to help. The rooms were spotless and cozy and the common areas made it easy to relax and meet other travelers.

Couldn’t recommend enough! || I stayed at Furaha House for 2 months while working remotely and I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Donatella the owner was very prompt at communicating and sorting out any issues (the wifi was upgraded while I was staying which took a while to get up and running but now works well).

Communicating with Donatella was easy and Nyama took good care of us, he is a super nice guy. Highly recommended! || Furaha house was nice and access to the beach is right there..... We asked for a Swahili breakfast and Nyama delivered. His hospitality was top notch.

We can improve on the room access from the balcony area since there is a lot of construction around the area.

Beautiful sunset views, but a disappointing dinner experience

We visited Peponi Hotel and Restaurant several times for drinks and once for dinner. It's a lovely place with beautiful views, especially around sunset. Some of the drinks were very reasonably priced, including a really good IPA, which was a pleasant surprise. It's a wonderful spot to sit, relax and watch the boats go by.

The only reason I'm giving it four stars rather than five is our experience during dinner. There was another party of seven, including four adults and three children. The children treated the restaurant like a playground, running around, screaming and throwing cushions. At one point, the youngest even climbed onto a table with his shoes on - hardly hygienic for the unfortunate guests who will next dine at this table. Disappointingly, the staff didn't seem to make any attempt to intervene.

It was a shame, as it really spoiled what should have been a relaxing dinner in an otherwise lovely setting. We'd certainly recommend the place for drinks and sunset views, but the restaurant could do a better job of maintaining a pleasant atmosphere for all its guests. || Peponi has an incredible history, atmosphere and soul, and you can feel that this is a very special place. Unfortunately, our experience was disappointing, particularly considering the hotel’s reputation and the price level.

The hotel feels very amateurishly run and lacks professionalism in several areas. The staff were generally not well trained and, unfortunately, not particularly welcoming, both at reception and in the restaurant.

Our Superior connecting rooms were very humid and not as clean as we expected. Our bed sheets even had holes. There were also some very basic things missing. Although we had a full kitchen, there were no glasses, cutlery or minibar. We only found towels in the kitchen. There were also no telephones in the rooms to contact reception, which is surprising for a hotel at this level. On another occasion, we waited an unnecessarily long time for something as basic as an umbrella, almost as if rain was an unusual occurrence in Lamu.

The restaurant was another disappointment. The food was okay, but nothing memorable, and we felt the menu could focus much more on local Swahili and East African dishes rather than trying to cover Thai, Italian and other international cuisines. It was surprising that there wasn’t even a simple grilled octopus on the menu, especially given the location. Breakfast service was particularly slow. Even something as basic and common in East Africa as mandazi had to be ordered a day in advance. That makes very little sense when you may simply feel like having one in the morning.

There was also considerable confusion around the daily boat shuttle to town. Despite this being a service the hotel operates every day, we had to wait almost 30 minutes while staff tried to organise it. When travelling with children and elderly family members, this kind of unnecessary waiting is frustrating and simply not what you expect from a hotel with such a strong reputation.

Overall, Peponi has the history, location and charm to be exceptional, but the service and management do not currently live up to the name. There is a lot of potential here, but the hotel needs much better-trained staff, more professional organisation and greater attention to basic guest needs.

For the price, we simply did not feel that we got value for money. The soul of Peponi is still there, but unfortunately the level of service and professionalism did not match the reputation or the rates. || Had an incredible stay at Peponi Hotel! Every single meal was absolutely amazing and beautifully presented. The staff are so friendly and welcoming, and the service throughout our visit was top-notch. On top of that, the views are breathtaking, and the whole place is kept spotless. Highly recommend || 5/5 - Exceptional in Every Sense of The Word
I have stayed in many hotels, but Peponi is in a class of its own.
Rooms: Exceptional. Impeccably clean, beautifully designed with that perfect Lamu Swahili charm, and so peaceful. You feel luxury without losing the soul of Lamu.

Service: Exceptional.The staff are warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. Nothing is too much to ask. You don't feel like a guest, you feel like family who has come home.

Food: Exceptional.Fresh, creative, and absolutely delicious. Every meal was a highlight.

But what truly touched me the most and makes me want to recommend Peponi to everyone: They treat their suppliers with the greatest dignity and love. Making them feel valued.

In an industry where suppliers are often overlooked, Peponi stands out. They treat everyone in their ecosystem with the same respect and kindness they show their guests. That says everything about the heart and values of this hotel. This is a business that understands true hospitality starts from within.

Peponi is not just a hotel, it's an experience of grace. I will definitely be back. || ​We visited Peponi specifically for dinner during our time in Lamu, and while we ultimately decided against staying at the hotel,since we were looking for air conditioning and a quieter, more private atmosphere,the restaurant itself was a highlight of our trip.

​The food was absolutely amazing. We had the crab prepared two ways, both the grinder and the curry, and both dishes were truly delicious. To complement the food, the service was impeccable from start to finish. My only real critique is the lighting; it was set so low that we actually had to use our phone torches just to see the food we were eating. It would be wonderful to see them add some better table lamps to help showcase the incredible dishes, but even with the dim lighting, it didn't take away from the fact that the meal was fantastic. If you are looking for top-tier food and great service in Lamu, this place is a must-visit.

5 star experience. Great place to disconnect from the city life. Walking distance to Shela and not far from Lamu town. We spent 5 days and wish we were able to stay longer.
