My 6 night stay was nothing short of  magical and even cried when I was leaving. I definitely intend on staying there again . || Baraka the house keeper is great. He assists with practically everything logistics. He will advise on what to do while in the area, where to get food, etc. He is super!
The house is also close to the beach. Less than 3 minutes walk.
Improvement areas: they can do a better job with the cleanliness of the place. It is a beautiful house that needs a lot done interms of keeping it. My bathroom kept blocking and I believe it could also be cleaner and more well kept.
I did enjoy my stay here but could have been better if the place were cleaner.

ResortName: Chuchungi House - The Safari Series, Lamu
ReviewText:
My husband and I had the best time at Chuchungi House. The place is gorgeous and just steps away from the beach. The food? Absolutely amazing—probably some of the best I’ve ever had. The staff were so kind and attentive, and there were lots of fun activities to keep us busy.

What I loved most was the location— it very quite and breezy, but just a speedboat ride from the lively vibe of Lamu and Shela. Perfect for logging off and relaxing. If you’re looking for a mix of chill and adventure, Chuchungi House is the place to be! || Our stay at Chuchungi House was just idyllic. We rolled from delicious meal to delicious meal with some chilling by the pool and water activities in between. The location was unbeatable, just 1 minute walk to the beach which was so quiet, with sometimes just only a donkey passing by! I love the house because you can see both the open Ocean and the calm creek. Considering how hot it was, we all stayed so cool in the house with breeze and fans and shade. The staff at Chuchungi were truly a delight - every interaction was a pleasure. They were warm, helpful, and made us feel right at home. My husband, a keen kite surfer, was in heaven - he said the conditions were perfect, making it the best kite surfing experience of his life! || Spent a magical week at Chuchungi House. The house is spacious, comfortable and calming with great views and a relaxing pool. Fresh seafood and sundowners on the beach, which being the other end of the island you practically have all to yourself. The team from Safari Series and at the house were incredibly helpful, warm and kind. Couldn't recommend more highly! || We had a wonderful weekend at Chuchungi House. We arrived to a warm welcome from the staff- and felt right at home thorughout. The team are so friendly and helpful - and the food from Chef Bernard was just fabulous! We loved relaxing on the roof terrace, soaking up the views of the dunes and ocean, it is perfect for yoga too. Watching the sunrise from bed was very special. This is the perfect place for quiet beach walks and swimming - we had a fun SUP excursion. The house is well kitted out for a host of water activities - and Captain Rama is always on hand to help out with your next water adventure. We had to work during our stay and appreciated the lightening fast Starlink internet. The sundowners and beach dinners were magical - we felt very spoilt by the team. Thank you for a wonderful stay! || A magical oasis - the perfect getaway from Real Life.
Morning swims in the sea, lazy afternoons in the hammock (or energetic afternoons kite surfing!) are all best rounded off with an incredible sundowner on the roof.
We also did the 14km walk along the beach from Chuchungi to Shela, and saw dolphins en route.

We had an absolutely amazing time at Jahazi House. We went as a 'girl tribe' and enjoyed the tranquility away from the buzzing city. We bonded,we goofed around and laughed hard..The staff (William, Kenga and Kazungu) were welcoming and affable. We loved watching the sunsets while seated at the jetty and captured beautiful silhouette pictures. Looking forward to visit again.
Thank you and God bless.
22nd-25th May..❤️ || Jahazi house was like a dream! This private villa on the water is stunning and sprinkled with many cozy spots for sunbathing/relaxing. Plus, you have access to everything you want in a beach vacation getaway because the professional and friendly staff have it all covered! From gourmet meals to sunset sails, visits to local towns and relaxing massages, you can leave your worries at the airport! Highly recommend and I hope to be back soon, thank you all! || I have never been to a place like this before - it feels like heaven on earth. We recently returned from a wonderful trip to Jahazi House: the house is stunning and the staff absolutely charming. Gaspard, Safari, Ali and Zohra made our holiday unforgettable and relaxing for the entire family. The house has a direct access to the beach and offers a very nice private pool. The owner also proposes a multitude of activities (water skiing, snorkeling, cycling, kayaking, massages...). Looking forward to our next trip to visit again. || Jahazi House is out of this world. Our stay was exceptional in every sense of the word - the location is stunning, beach front and beautiful ocean. Professional, friendly and super staff, amazing food, brilliant activities on offer, stunning house.   In 11 years in Kenya it's the most loveliest place I have ever stayed! || Words do not do justice to the fantastic location, the beautiful villa, the incredible staff and the overall experience at Jahazi house. Set on the most picturesque beach, you instantly feel like you are in a paradise haven. With easy access to all the sites through the private boat and Ali the boat driver - we saw everything we could have possibly wanted (including swimming with Dolphins). Gaspar and Safari crafted the most amazing, mouth-watering menu. The whole experience was beyond anything we could have expected and even though I don't want to share this incredible secret get-away with the world, I feel I must just in order to pay hommage to Eric, the staff and the superb experience they provided us with.

Address: Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
ReviewText:
We hosted our Annual Retreat of 75 people at Enashipai and we couldn't get a better service than this! The team was so smooth to help us coordinate everything, from welcoming, to food, to conferencing, to leisure activities and rooming.
We had an amazing time and everyone talked with great words about Enashipai and it's staff. Huge kiddos to Amy the Manager who did a fantastic job coordinating everything for us! || Magnificent is an understatement! World-class is not enough! Enashipai, as the Maasai word suggests, truly lives up to its name.

From the moment you enter through the gate, you are welcomed by beautifully manicured lawns, cabro-paved roads, and well-tended and preserved indigenous trees. This is what differentiates Enashipai from many of the 5-star hotels I have visited. The entire property is thoughtfully designed, with buildings well spaced out rather than crammed together like apartments. Instead, the rooms are arranged in beautifully designed villa-style units.

The rooms are exceptionally spacious, very clean, and clearly well thought out from the planning stage. I particularly found the open-bathroom design in some of the first-floor rooms near the pools to be unique and attractive.

The food was awesome, and I really appreciated the flexible serving times. Guests did not have to jostle or cram into the restaurant at the same time, making the whole dining experience much more relaxed.

And you cannot forget the ingenious electric carts that transport guests to and from the rooms and reception. Given how spacious the property is, these carts are extremely convenient and make moving around the resort effortless.

Most importantly, the staff are exceptional—courteous, helpful, polite, and genuinely committed to making guests comfortable. Even the security personnel and cleaners were incredibly courteous. They did not just feel like employees; they felt like part of the Enashipai community. You can see that they take ownership of their work and are passionate about what they do.

I certainly cannot forget Milka at the reception, who was kind, professional, and took her time to explain everything to us. And of course, Esther at the head office, who was excellent at finding solutions, has impressive negotiation skills, and always tries to find something that works for the customer’s needs.

Overall, Enashipai has a great foundation and well-functioning systems, but what impressed me most is that they seem to offer more than just a hotel stay—they offer an experience.

My wife, my kids, and I had an absolute blast. We will definitely be going back! || Beautiful place! The rooms were good, the food kinda ok (not the best i had in kenya, but really ok), and the lake view was very nice.
Plenty of kids and family activities, the most i saw in a resort in kenya. || We enjoyed our brief stay at Enashipai being greeted with a lovely welcome drink.

Our room was beautifully decorated and reasonably close to the reception. Not sure that the shared lounge in each cottage configuration works for unrelated groups, and we left the space to the group who'd arrived first. Fortunately, there are other spaces available to enjoy.

We were rather looking forward to the bar overlooking the lake but were disappointed to find this closed - only opens late in the week. We ended up in Oltepesi bar and were lucky that the pool players finished up shortly so we could enjoy a quiet drink.

The resort is quite big and there were lots of happy children enjoying themselves, so definitely good for families. There's also childminding and a playroom at the pool area.

Our general impressions were that Enashipai is a great destination for family holidays, meetings and conferences, but not so much catered for a tourist experience.

Still, a handy location for the activities we were undertaking around the area, great buffet with amazingly delicious food and helpful, friendly staff. || Enashipai Resort was absolutely amazing. The staff provided stellar service from start to finish, even while accommodating a huge wedding party we came with. Everyone was helpful, attentive, and genuinely kind.

I especially appreciated how supportive they were before and after my tooth extraction. They went above and beyond by helping me get cloves and even preparing off-menu meals so I could eat comfortably and maintain sustenance while recovering.

Beautiful resort, great hospitality, and a team that truly cares. Highly recommend.

Address: Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
ReviewText:
Given the considerable size of the establishment, rooms situated at the hotel's entrance may require a short walk, though it is not excessively inconvenient. The restaurant offers a pleasant dining experience, complemented by exceptional staff.

Notably, a unique attraction at the front of the hotel features hippos, alongside a "hippo whisperer" who has trained them to approach and open their mouths, which is quite remarkable. While an electric fence is present, it is currently inactive; guests should remain mindful of this. || Lake Naivasha Resort exceeded my expectations. The rooms were clean, spacious, and comfortable, with beautiful views of the lake and gardens. The staff were warm, professional, and always willing to help. The food was delicious with plenty of variety, and the peaceful atmosphere made it the perfect place to relax. I especially enjoyed the boat ride and the chance to see hippos and birds up close. Whether for a family vacation, a romantic getaway, or a conference, I highly recommend this resort. I'll definitely be back! || For a 5-star hotel, this property fell incredibly short of luxury standards.
• Sluggish Service,The staff was unacceptably slow to respond when I raised an issue, requiring multiple follow-ups.
• Missing Essentials,The room was poorly prepared, lacking basic essentials that should be standard upon arrival.
• Outdated TV in-room technology is ancient. The TV was old, slow, and barely functioned.
A premium price should guarantee premium service. I cannot recommend staying here until management upgrades the rooms and trains their staff on efficiency. || Super service. We were over 2k guests and service was excellent. A lotion improvement. Parking was the only nightmare with such big numbers and should be coordinated better. You know your Parking capacity..make arrangements early for extra parking,  and guide guests accordingly.

Meals were served in record times. There were enough service spots. The toilets were clean by the minute. We'll done on this one. The team was super. Hope you rewarded them well.... || The staff are very professional, food is great and in plenty, the resident Hippos are friendly and fun to watch as they are being fed. They know their names and understand Swahili. I highly recommend the Resort. I was attending the annual NACOSTI Research Integrity Training 2026.

We had an incredible experience staying here. The resort grounds are absolutely stunning, lush, and peaceful. Being able to see wildlife like zebras, giraffes, and waterbucks roaming freely right outside the rooms made the stay truly magical.
​The rooms were spacious, clean, and very comfortable. The staff were exceptionally warm, welcoming, and always ready to help. The food was delicious with plenty of variety. It’s the perfect place to relax and connect with nature. Highly recommended, and I would definitely love to visit again! || Lake Naivasha Sopa Resort is a beautiful property in a fantastic setting. The grounds are home to lots of wildlife, including zebras, giraffes, and other animals that freely graze around the resort. Our room had a great view of the grounds and lake, and the balcony was a wonderful place to sit and watch the zebras. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom had everything we needed, and the restaurant offered a large buffet with a good variety of food.

There were a few downsides. Our room was quite hot, and the provided fan only runs on a 60-minute timer, so we had to get up several times during the night to turn it back on. The doors also don’t have screens, making it difficult to air out the room without potentially inviting monkeys or other wildlife inside.

Unfortunately, we also woke up to find that a rodent had gotten into our luggage, chewed through a bag, and eaten a significant amount of our food. This definitely put a damper on our stay. I don’t necessarily blame the property, as these things can happen at a resort surrounded by wildlife, but I think adding screens to the balcony and front doors would be an important improvement. It would allow guests to ventilate their rooms while keeping animals outside.

Overall, this is a beautiful property with a unique experience, and watching zebras and giraffes right outside your room was a highlight of our stay. || Naivasha Sopa Lodge is an excellent place to relax and unwind. Unfortunately, we stayed here for only one night, but it was one of the most enjoyable stays of our trip.

The service was outstanding, and the food was excellent, with a wide variety of options available at every meal. The head chef personally checked with guests to ensure they were satisfied with the food, which was a thoughtful touch.

The rooms have a slightly older style, but they are spacious, comfortable, and equipped with all the essential amenities. The bathrooms are clean and well maintained, with hot water available at all times. As this is an older property, USB charging ports are not available in the rooms, so carrying a universal adapter is recommended.

One of the highlights of the lodge is its beautiful grounds, where zebras, giraffes, and waterbucks roam freely. We were fortunate to see many of them right outside our room. Being a lakefront property, the lodge also offers excellent views of the lake, where you can spot plenty of hippos during the daytime.

The property itself is quite large, and a buggy service is available to transport guests to and from their rooms, which is especially helpful after a long day of activities.

Overall, Naivasha Sopa Lodge offers a perfect combination of comfort, wildlife, and hospitality, making it a wonderful place to stay in Naivasha. || Really beautiful. The atmosphere and scenery are breathtaking. The animals going around are simply wow. I love that the staff is not intrusive, especially with the luggages, unlike other hotels/lodges (i like to bring my own stuff and be on my own, also going to the room). The food is spectacular. The views are amazing. The pool is kinda cold, but with the beautiful (and very strong) sun from Kenya and a little breeze is really enjoyable. Found a few flying insects in the room after arriving but I managed to squat them easily. All is good. || Extremely disappointing — completely unacceptable for a 4-star hotel

The property is stunning, the staff were friendly, and I have no complaints about the food or anything else during our stay. Unfortunately, the handling of a basic issue was extremely disappointing.

At around 8pm, after my friend showered, we had no hot water. We waited 30 minutes before calling reception and were told someone would come. After another 20 minutes, nobody had arrived, so we called again. A housekeeping member eventually came and genuinely tried to help, but we were told the hot water supply had been depleted.

As we were already late for dinner, I had to shower in completely cold water — not even remotely lukewarm. I was then taken in my bathrobe and half-showered to two other rooms, neither of which had hot water, before returning to my room to finish the cold shower.

What should have been a simple issue turned into three hours of back-and-forth, finally ending around 11pm. The eventual resolution was simply to waive our $30 drinks bill. While the housekeeping staff did try to help, this should have been the minimum gesture of goodwill, not something that took hours of discussion.

For a 4-star resort charging around $300 a night, this was simply not an acceptable level of service recovery. Things go wrong, but it is how they are handled that matters — and unfortunately, this was handled very poorly.

Address: Off Moi S Lake Road, Karagita, Kenya
ReviewText:
A dreamlike place with very friendly and attentive staff and a breathtaking view of Lake Naivasha. The absolute highlight for us were the zebras and giraffes wandering around the garden!
In the afternoon coffee and tea are served for hotel guests. In the evening, they made a big bonfire in the garden, creating such a beautiful and cosy atmosphere.
The rooms were clean, but they are a little outdated and could use some renovation. The food was also good. || was here this past weekend with my partner and we had only planned to have a meal there but we loved the place so much we ended up staying there the whole weekend

the place is really lovely, it makes you feel immersed and one with nature!
the service and the food is exceptional, the rooms need a little renovation but aside from that everything else was top tier

I genuinely had the best time here and it will always have a special place in my heart✨️ || Highlight of our 2 weeks in Kenya, this place is unbelievable! Right on the water, amazing animals around both day and night, you feel completely immersed in nature. The food was delicious and the chef went above and beyond for my vegan friend. As a pescetarian myself there was alot of choice, I was particularly pleased with the veggie Indian food, including gobi machurian one lunch! There is also afternoon tea and cake which was a nice touch. The full body aromatherapy massage was one of the best i've ever had and the massage area has stunning views of the lake. Above all else, the staff are what really makes this place. The reception staff in particular the female receptionist was so friendly and professional. Stay for two nights if you can  to completely relax. It is also close to Hells Gate which is well worth visiting if you have the time. Only recommendation I have for improvement is the mosquito net around the bed had come off the rail in some places so wouldn't be too effective. Even so, I only got one mosquito bite in two nights despite sleeping with the windows open, as there are bug shield things on the windows. || The location is amazing, right in front of the lake. We loved being able to see hippos, zebras, and other animals from the terrace, such a unique experience.

The rooms are a bit dated, but the service was excellent and the food was also very good. The staff really made us feel welcome.

Overall, we had a really pleasant stay and truly enjoyed the atmosphere and wildlife around the hotel. || Very good hotel with TV in the room. The food is great with lot of Indian and Vegetarian options. The main highlight is the presence of wild animals on the property and spotting of Hippos in the night.

Address: 114 Moi S Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
ReviewText:
A great spot to settle and adjust to the new time zone before heading out on safari. Rooms are very lovely. Staff is warm and helpful. The property is entertaining - hippos, and lots of monkeys. Food is great too. We went to Hell's Gate for the day, which was worth a look. || To market themselves as "luxury" is laughable. If it were possible to give minus stars, I would. The room had a kitchen! Why! With nothing in it, empty cupboards, not a plate, pan or utensils. The black mold encrusted bathroom was vile. My shower gel had been opened, it was used, the tiles in the shower were lethal when wet and no grab rail. The one towel was thin and grey, there was no hairdryer; the bedding was poor quality and the bottom sheet was torn. When I plugged in my charger the entire socket fell out of the wall. The whole place looks tired and run-down and the staff are disinterested. It was horrible, dreadful, awful. Don't stay here! || Osotua Resort in Naivasha offers a peaceful setting with beautiful lake views and spacious villas. The rooms are clean, well furnished, and ideal for both short and extended stays. The environment is quiet and refreshing, perfect for relaxation or team retreats. The staff are professional and attentive, and the check-in process is smooth. Meals are enjoyable, though menu variety could improve to match the resort’s high standards. WiFi and minor maintenance issues may need attention, but overall, the experience is pleasant and worth recommending for anyone visiting Naivasha. || We had an incredibly relaxing, luxurious stay at the end our safari to decompress.  We were pampered all entire time. The food and service are outstanding and we left fully recharged. The staff are all incredibly friendly,  courteous and attentive. Food is delicious and the grounds are immaculately kept. The campfire at the end of the night while sitting around with friends enjoying drinks was the cherry on top. Highly recommended! || Osotua Luxury Resort by Lake Naivasha is peaceful and stylish, with spacious villas, beautiful lake views, and three relaxing pools. Rooms are well-equipped, and the staff is friendly and helpful. Great base for boat rides, safaris, or visits to Hell’s Gate. A perfect mix of comfort and nature!
We had an early breakfast per our guide guidance, the staff were there early for us, very nice!!

Address: Moi South Lake Rd, Naivasha, Kenya
ReviewText:
We enjoyed every aspect of our stay at Burch's resort.
The establishment is at a convenient location; lakefront and not too far from town.
We were traveling with our kids and the resort organized awesome interconnecting rooms. Rooms are very well maintained.
The kids loved pool time and cycling around the premises.
Food was flavorful with a wide variety daily.
The staff are awesome.
I'd visit again and would certainly recommend it! || I recently had the opportunity to stay at **Burch's Resort**, and overall, it was a pleasant experience. The resort enjoys a great location, offering a peaceful environment that's perfect for both leisure and business travelers. The rooms are spacious, clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making for a relaxing stay.

The conference facilities are also decent and suitable for meetings, workshops, and corporate events. They provide a good working environment, although there is still room for enhancement to make them even more competitive.

One area that needs urgent attention is the parking area. Unfortunately, it is neither paved nor well maintained, and since it's the very first thing guests encounter upon entering the resort, it doesn't create the best first impression. Improving the parking would significantly enhance the overall guest experience.

The food is generally delicious, with a good variety and quality. However, the management could improve their meal planning. On several occasions, some of the most popular dishes ran out before everyone had been served, or chefs minimize on portioning, suggesting that guest numbers may not be accurately factored into their food preparation estimates. Better forecasting would ensure all guests enjoy the full menu throughout meal times.

I also sympathize with the resort regarding the challenges brought about by the rising water levels of Lake Naivasha. The lake has expanded beyond its banks, and sadly, some of the beautiful bungalow accommodations have been submerged. This is clearly a natural disaster beyond the resort's control, and I hope conditions improve so they can restore these facilities in the future.

Despite these few shortcomings, I had a comfortable and enjoyable stay. With improvements to the parking area and food quantity planning, Burch's Resort has the potential to offer an even better guest experience. I would certainly consider visiting again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful getaway or a conference venue around Lake Naivasha. || AVOID THIS HOTEL IF YOU ARE IN TOWN FOR BUSINESS.

Let me start by being objective, for the sake of fairness. Good location, staff seem good.

We stayed on a Thursday night, specifically asked at reception whether there would be a party. We were told there is no party.

Later, coming back from dinner at 8.30, we heard music from the hotel restaurant. We asked again what time it would stop - we were told by 9pm.

It is now 1am in the morning and music is still banging from the hotel restaurant, people are screaming. It's impossible to sleep with this racket. Tomorrow is a work day. I have called reception several times but they seem unable to do anything about this. Extremely disappointing.

I do not recommend staying here if you want any kind of sleep at night. || A lovely place, excellent service, great layout, wonderful ambience, very relaxing atmosphere. The boat rides are a highlight.
A few improvements to enhance the overall guest experience: keep the food, tea, milk hot, provide games such as Scrabble and darts, introduce evening and night entertainment. || Great service, friendly staff, easy to access via maps, good food

The hotel is very beautiful, with a lovely setting and a great atmosphere. However, compared to other hotels and lodges we stayed at, the staff were not quite as warm and friendly. They were not rude at all, but they could have been a little more welcoming and smiling.
The restaurant service was also a bit slow, especially when it came to drinks. On a few occasions, I had already finished my meal before my drink arrived.
We were three people staying in the room, but there was not enough shampoo or shower gel provided for three guests. We later asked for more, as well as slippers. The extra toiletries were provided, but the slippers were never brought to the room. || The best experience ever! All round accommodation. Suitable for all, family, business, conferences, wedding with a variety of indoor and outdoor activities.

Very spacious rooms, with a touch of architectural beauty incorperating nature.

Aawela all the way. || Wonderful place to visit, work, and refresh. The service is very warm and inviting, carefully minding different needs. Richard was especially kind and selflessly ensured my stay was memorable! 👏🏽 👏🏽 The food is also amazing || An exquisite ,warm ,tranquil Resort Lodge. Strategically located on the shores of Lake Naivasha giving superior and world class services on conference (with huge capacity meeting rooms and array of breakout rooms) , leisure and business accommodation.  The rooms are spacious and Immaculate with warm appealing decor, elegantly, thoughtfully and tastefully furnished. Giving a rich classy vibe. The Management and staff are professional, accomodative and amiable and easily accessible for consultation and quality service. || U really need to work on service we had a blast especially when. They was a period where the lights went then came back every ones was celebrating that one moment we really loved your stay thx for the boat ride and I cant wait for the wedding section to be finished being built

ResortName: Great Rift Valley Lodge & Golf Resort
Address: Moi North Lake Road, Naivasha, Kenya
ReviewText:
The Great Rift Valley Lodge & Golf Resort is one of those places that leaves you feeling as though you’ve temporarily stepped out of ordinary life. Set against the breathtaking panorama of the Great Rift Valley, the lodge effortlessly combines rustic charm with beautiful surroundings and a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere.

The ambience is warm, rustic and inviting, with picturesque views at every turn. One of the highlights was simply taking in the scenery while watching the beautiful animals roaming around the property it was a lovely reminder of just how spectacular Kenya’s landscape can be.

The service was another standout. The staff were affable, attentive and prompt without ever being intrusive, which made the entire stay feel easy and comfortable. The food was also very good, with a satisfying variety and quality that complemented the experience.

For those who enjoy being active, there is plenty to do. The tennis courts and bicycles are a wonderful touch, offering a fun way to explore the grounds and enjoy the fresh air. Equally, there is no shortage of opportunities to simply sit back, breathe and admire the view.

Overall, The Great Rift Valley Lodge offers a beautiful blend of nature, tranquillity, recreation and warm hospitality. Whether you are looking for a peaceful escape, a romantic getaway or simply somewhere to reconnect with the beauty of the Rift Valley, this is a place I would happily return to.

A truly memorable stay and an easy five stars. || I had the best experience here. Staff were vibrant, courteous and helpful. My room was abit far from the reception but the driver never grew tired of my multiple trips to the tennis court, reception or dining area. Props to Antony Naserian, most courteous staff💯 || The view from the rooms is simply breath taking. The service from the staff is awesome. The food is very delicious totally recommend the place. So many activities for the children to do. Swimming, bicycles are available for all children above 8 years to adults, golf ⛳, badminton, tennis, leisure nature walks accompanied by someone who has alot of knowledge about nature occasional sighting of wild animals, we saw warthogs || A fantastic resort with everything you need to relax and unwind.

The golf course is magnificent, and the beautifully paved walkways leading to the rooms are surrounded by lush greenery, creating a peaceful atmosphere.If you enjoy working out, the resort has a well-equipped gym. There are also plenty of other activities to enjoy, including swimming pools and a children's play area, making it ideal for both couples and families.

I was fortunate to get a room with a breathtaking view, almost like a penthouse experience, overlooking the stunning Great Rift Valley. The rooms are spacious, comfortable, and beautifully designed.

Overall, a wonderful destination that combines comfort, recreation, and spectacular scenery. I would definitely recommend it. || I
MOST AMAZING: WERE THE HAPPY VARIOUS WILD ANIMAL ROAMING AROUND IN THE EVERYTHING AND EARLY MORNING, SUCH SPECTACULAR VIEWS!
THEN THEU HAVE GOD SUCH AMAZING VARIETIES OF BOTH LOCAL & INTERNATIONAL FRESH FOODS! THAT WAS VERY ENJOYABLE, ESPECIALLY WITH EXCELLENT STAFFS THERE ,the likes of Alice, Peter, Cynthia amongst othery

The swimming pool and the gym are state of the art! Really enjoyed them for sure.

All in all, I hope I never come back here again. Was quite a tougher stay for me.

Paradise found! What a place this is, no words can describe the idyllic setting, it is wonderful. Breakfast by the lake watching hippos grunting in the water, coming up for air wiggling their ears. The staff are so kind, friendly and attentive, nothing is too much trouble. You stay in a beautiful bungalow by the lake with antelope gambling across the lawn and monkeys chittering in the trees. And all that before you've been on safari! The guides are knowledgeable and find everything. We've seen black and white rhino, so close that you feel like you could just put out your hand and touch them. Beautiful giraffes, buffalo's, warthog, jackals, zebras, lions. Just incredible. The food is also top draw, absolutely delicious. Coming here is life changing, it is a truly wonderful experience. 5 stars is not enough ✨️ || An unbelievable setting in a magical place. Can’t say enough great things about the staff. Solomon, Cedric, Constant, Cynthia, and Simon, just to name a few blew us away with their kindness and attentiveness. Samuel or guide was superb. I wish he could follow us to our next camp. I highly recommend Loldia House as a great home away from home. || I was so spoilt, alone traveller who felt extremely safe on her first Safari. What a beautiful place. The Staff are so attentive, meals fulfilling, tasty . I didn't want to leave || The room was spacious and clean, nice water pressure in the bathrooms and many amenities to choose from. Housekeepeing was on point and a special commendation to Shadrack.

The service was impeccable, our server Solomon was amazing, despite only being here three weeks from the mara camp, he knew everything and was always there to help us. From an empty glass making sure it was filled, a water droplet on my phone and he brought serviettes to clean the phone, to our taste and preference. He sorted us out and made sure we had a effortless, enjoyable and relaxing anniversary getaway.
Our guide for the night drive was also on point and knew his stuff, professional driving and etiquette. I believe his name was Samuel.
Even the pool attendant was helpful and friendly.

The food was excellent, apart from one lunch which I personally only didn’t enjoy, however the rest loved it.

The location: right by the water and excellent views with the hippos giving us some entertainment.
Excellent infinity pool overlooking the lake.
I would say this place is to relax and see small game, not the place to see exciting action on safari, big animals or the common predators which people go on safari for.

However, a tranquil, relaxing break from Nairobi.
We loved it. || The most wonderful stay at Loldia House.
Absolutely beautiful hotel & surroundings on Lake Naivasha. Great place to experience a whole host of wildlife on the game drives & boat trips also.

Our game driver Juma was excellent, so informative and knowledgable we were lucky to have you showing us around!

The food was amazing, so delicious & the service was impeccable.
All staff are so friendly & welcoming - special thanks to Simon our waiter, Samuel and Peter in housekeeping & Cynthia on reception for making our honeymoon trip so special, we thank you all very much & hope to see you again soon!

ReviewText:
We stayed for one night at Lake Naivasha Kongoni Lodge during our safari in Kenya, and we received a very warm welcome from the very first moment.

One of the real highlights was definitely the nature walk with Eden, a member of the lodge staff and a naturalist. He shared his knowledge with us and gave us the opportunity to truly connect with the nature and vegetation around us. He told us about his land, introduced us to the local plants, and even let us discover their different scents (literally!). It was such a beautiful and unexpected way to learn more about the environment surrounding us.

At the end of the walk, he also took us down to the lake to see the hippos, continuing to share lots of fascinating facts and interesting information with us.

If you happen to stay at Kongoni Lodge, take an hour to go on this walk: reconnect with nature and treat yourself to a truly special experience with someone who is kind, passionate, and above all, incredibly knowledgeable.

Highly recommended! || I didn't like my experience at this property.

My family of four spent 1 night there. The rooms were spacious, the beds comfortable and had great showers but other basic things were off - electrical outlets were not always located in the most logical places such as on each side of the beds and the lighting was very blue and felt like prison lighting.

The food was also very basic and not consistently tasty. Some dishes felt like they were after thoughts such as a lemon cake that tasted nothing like lemon and a carrot cake with the same issue.

Service was also average at best. Waiters didn't do anything wrong, they just were not as polished as those in other properties we stayed at while in Kenya.

During check-in we were pitched the same walking tour three times even though it was clear we were not interested the first time it was mentioned to us.

In fairness, I am comparing this property to properties elsewhere in Kenya that while not pricier had fewer rooms and were a lot more intimate but even there, the food was consistently superior and service was extremely polished and catering to our needs.

I would unfortunately not stay at this property again and would only recommend if you are truly looking for a value stay with no frills and basic food. || We were a group of 5 adults for one night at Kongoni lodge. I am writing this review after a one-night stay at this luxury camp.

What I liked:

- The room was very spacious.
- The washroom was well designed, with separate sections for the toilet, shower, and hand-wash area.
- There was adequate storage space inside the camp.
- Lighting and charging points were conveniently placed.
- Room service was good.

- The campsite surroundings were beautiful, and the swimming pool was well maintained.

Areas for Improvement / Disappointing Experience:

I booked a full-board accommodation package.

Upon arrival, we clearly informed the staff that we are vegetarians. However, for dinner we were presented with a menu containing beef, mutton, and chicken options, while the only vegetarian choice available was spaghetti. This was quite disappointing and not what I would expect from a property offering full-board accommodation.

When I asked whether other vegetarian options were available, I was informed that the menu was fixed and limited. As a result, I had very few choices, and my wife was also left with limited options.

We also requested the breakfast and lunch menus for the following day, but they were never provided.

The breakfast experience was the most disappointing part of our stay. The available options were mainly potatoes, bananas, eggs, and beef. As a vegetarian, I was left with almost nothing suitable to eat and ended up having only banana and watermelon.

I raised my concerns with the reception desk. The management later contacted me, apologized for the inconvenience, and assured me that they would improve the vegetarian menu and provide multiple options for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian guests.

The property itself is beautiful, the rooms are spacious, and the staff were courteous. However, if you are a vegetarian, I strongly recommend confirming the menu options before booking.

My request to future travelers: Please read this review carefully and check whether the management has genuinely implemented improvements for vegetarian guests. A standard apology is easy to give, but meaningful changes to the menu are what truly matter.

ReviewText:
**An Unforgettable Stay at Elewana Sand River Masai Mara**

An absolutely outstanding experience from start to finish\! The service, food and experiences were exceptional, and every staff member was so warm, friendly and welcoming\.

Our guide, Alex, was fabulous — incredibly knowledgeable about the wildlife and local Maasai traditions\. We arrived at 11 am and by 7 pm that evening, we had spotted an incredible **27 different animal species**\!

Highlights included our hot\-air balloon adventure and bush breakfast, sunset drinks, and the magical bush bar with a roaring fire and local Maasai people sharing their traditions and culture\.

Every detail was thoughtfully taken care of, making our stay truly special\. We couldn’t recommend Elewana Sand River Masai Mara highly enough\. A truly unforgettable African safari experience\! 🐘🦁🌅 || Ii cannot say enough wonderful things about this experience. The accommodations were awesome and the staff beyond helpful
And considerate and kind. The nice little touches like the chef discussing our preferences and portion sizes to the intimate fires and cakes with singing for my retirement to the hot water bottles in our beds every night that surprisingly stayed warm even until morning. Our guide Benjamin was beyond my wildest dreams as far as knowledge and experience and ensured with patience we saw all we desired and created beautiful photo ops.  It was sad to have to leave as everyone made you feel so welcomed and respected.  Experience of a lifetime || This is a fantastic camp--superb location, staff, setting, food, etc. I've been to a bunch in East and Southern Africa, and it's always a bit hard to know in advance what things will be like. To those reading: this has been the best I've visited, and worth every penny. Thanks to Hannah, Scott, Kevin, Jason, Victor, and all the staff for everything! || I cannot recommend Elewana Sand River enough — just book it, blindly.

Our guide Joel and our butler Juma made this the trip of a lifetime, and the managers Hannah and Scott were absolutely fantastic.

A note that really mattered to us as a family: the property is split into Big Sand and Little Sand, with separate dining areas. Our room was at the far end, technically closer to Little Sand, and the walk back through the bush at night — even with the night guards escorting you — genuinely terrified our young daughter. We simply asked if we could dine at Little Sand instead, and they accommodated it without hesitation. Traveling with a 7 and 10 year old, that kind of flexibility means everything.

Joel suggested an 11-hour game drive to cover more ground. Honestly, no one expects to do that with two young kids — but we completely trusted him, and it turned out to be the best experience of the whole trip. The kids were absolutely fine, he kept us captivated with facts the entire time, and his patience was unreal.

He was determined we'd find all of the Big Five, and thanks to his knowledge of the area, we even spotted the elusive leopard! Not once but 2 different leopards!

The food deserves its own mention. Juma made sure the kids were pampered at every meal. I celebrated my 40th birthday here, and they organized a beautiful bush sundowner with exceptional food — and Dan at the bar made sure my wine glass was never empty.

The love, hospitality, and warmth here are truly exceptional. We left with the most incredible memories. Do not think twice — stay at Elewana Sand River. || Sand river is an incredible location!  Not only is the view beautiful, but the staff ensures you are treated like you are the only one here !
