⭐ 1 STAR — Extremely Disappointing Experience

I strongly advise against staying at AA  Lodge, especially if you are traveling with a group or children.

I booked this property approximately six months in advance for a group of 25 people for August 7–9, 2026. Unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing from the moment we arrived.

At check-in, our rooms were not ready, and the lodge did not have enough rooms available for our group despite the reservation being made months in advance. The front desk staff were also extremely rude and dismissive. While we were trying to resolve these issues, other guests would arrive and staff would repeatedly push our group to the side to assist them, leaving us waiting despite having already booked and paid for our stay well in advance.

There were also serious issues with the rooms and basic amenities. The showers were not functioning properly, there was no hot water, and the water pressure was inadequate. We had children with us, including 10 local children who were part of our experience, and they were unable to properly shower or even brush their teeth because of the water situation.

The way some of the staff interacted with and looked at the children in our group was also uncomfortable and disappointing. Given that we were bringing children into the property as part of a cultural experience, I expected them to be treated with basic warmth and respect.

To make matters worse, we were overcharged for two guests even though the lodge did not actually have the rooms available for those guests.

We repeatedly asked to speak with the manager, John, to resolve the situation. We were told he was unavailable and, after approximately seven hours, still had not come out to properly address the issues with us.

Eventually, we were told that the lodge would provide us with a credit due to the problems we experienced. However, when we later attempted to use that credit, it was politely declined. This was extremely frustrating because we had been given a clear expectation that the credit would be honored.

Another thing to be aware of is that essentially everything comes at an additional cost. Even basic bottled water and drinks were not complimentary, meaning we had to continually pay for water and other necessities throughout the stay.

Overall, this was one of the most frustrating accommodation experiences I’ve had. We booked six months in advance, brought a large group, had children with us, and expected the rooms and basic amenities we had paid for to be available.

Instead, we dealt with missing rooms, broken/insufficient showers, no hot water, poor water pressure, overcharging, extremely poor communication, dismissive customer service, and a promised credit that was later refused.

I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere, particularly if you are traveling with a large group or children. The experience did not come close to the standard of service we expected or the money we paid. || We had all inclusive Africa tour with Kolkata based local operator Sunny tours and travels; in Africa it was managed by Africa keys - due to payment dispute between ST&T and Afirca Keys - Africa keys colluded and AA Lodge Masai Mara (on 25th August during check out) to keep the gate closed, withdraw the transport, held us hostage threatening us to pay personally else will be handed over to locals - all passengers were forced to pay USD 460 pn/ per head (USD 920 for me & wife) - 2.5 days of itinerary was withheld and we had been on our own - PLEASE avoid these DANGEROUS elements, they can put your LIFE AT SEVERE RISK || I’m giving 1 Star ⭐️because I have to.  I Would Not Stay Here Again

My experience at AA Lodge Maasai Mara was extremely disappointing, especially considering what they charge tourists.

My room had insects, including bugs in the shower, and the overall condition of the room did not match what I expected for the price. The food was also not good, and nearly everything came with an additional charge. Even basic things like bottled water were overpriced.

What bothered me most was the feeling that many of the prices were designed for tourists who simply don’t know any better. Having now spent time traveling around Kenya, the cost versus the quality and level of service here just did not make sense.

Our group also experienced issues with rooms not being ready or available despite being booked well in advance, problems with hot water and water pressure, and frustrating customer service when trying to get those issues resolved.

The Maasai Mara itself is incredible and absolutely worth experiencing. This lodge is not.

There are too many accommodation options in the area for me to recommend spending your money here. I would strongly suggest researching other properties before booking AA Lodge. || A nice hotel. Very close to the Masai Mara reserve gates (around 5-10 minutes by car). The rooms are fine, with some repairs required (e.g. the light switch was missing buttons) but overall quite clean and comfortable. The staff, while friendly, unfortunately is hit or miss — especially when it comes to food allergies. Some requests are just forgotten about. However, if you are persistent, you will get what you ordered in the end. || It was our first lodge, and the welcome felt straight out of The White Lotus—we definitely didn’t expect it! The reception area is beautiful, the staff is lovely, and the cabins look great from the outside. First impressions are very positive, and it definitely has the right atmosphere and vibe for a safari.

My only comment is that the rooms could use a little more maintenance. In our room, for example, the sliding closet door was off its track and leaning against the wall, and the toilet had a small water leak. But these are minor details that didn’t really matter at first because it was our first safari experience.

The lodge is in a privileged location, very close to the Maasai Mara. At night, you can hear lions roaring and a whole range of sounds you never imagined you would hear. It’s quite an experience.

Address: Maasai Mara National Reserve, River, Talek, Kenya
ReviewText:
An unforgettable stay at JW Marriott Masai Mara! The setting is spectacular, but the people truly made our experience special.

A huge thank-you to Chef Monu Thakar for the wonderful food and personal attention; our guide, Frances, for making our game drives so memorable; and Lewis at the bar for his warm hospitality. Both Dorises also deserve special recognition for their kindness and attentive service throughout our stay.

The team made us feel so welcome and cared for. A truly special safari experience—we would love to return! || We stayed at JW Marriott Masai Mara in mid-September 2026, and honestly, it was a wonderful experience from start to finish.

The property itself is beautiful and sits right on the banks of the Talek River. It feels wonderfully raw and wild, yet at the same time you have all the comfort and luxury you would expect from a JW Marriott. There is a hippo pool right near the entrance, and we saw several hippos there, along with baboons and so many beautiful birds around the property. It was lovely to be surrounded by wildlife even when we were not out on a game drive.

The rooms are huge, very comfortable and equipped with all modern amenities. It really gives you that rare combination of being in the middle of the wilderness while still having the comforts of home.

But what truly made our stay special was the people.

Mr. Nelson from housekeeping was wonderful and took great care of us. He is also an excellent bird expert and very kindly dedicated an entire morning to showing us the birds around the property. That was such a lovely and unexpected experience.

Mr. Francis and Mr. Patrick at the restaurant were fantastic. They took special care of my vegetarian requirements and always made sure I had something delicious to eat. They also packed so much wonderful food for our picnic lunches during the game drives. What made it even more enjoyable were their stories about the Maasai Mara — meals with them were not just about food, but also about getting to know the place and its people.

A special mention to Chef Bhuvan, who made things incredibly easy for us by preparing delicious, comforting food that felt almost like home cooking. We really appreciated his effort.

Mr. Viktor, the bartender, brought so much energy to the evenings. His drinks around the bonfire were wonderful, and he added a lot of fun and warmth to our stay.

Ms. Doris at the front desk was always so warm and welcoming. Every time we met her, she greeted us with such genuine warmth that it immediately made us feel at home.

And then there was Mr. Eric, our guide, who deserves a special mention. I can honestly say he was one of the best safari guides we have ever had. He took us on several game drives through the Mara Triangle, Sand River and Musiara Marsh areas and put in so much effort to give us the best possible experience. His knowledge of the wildlife and his enthusiasm were fantastic, and he was always patient and willing to go the extra mile to get us a great sighting.

Overall, what we will remember most about JW Marriott Masai Mara is not just the beautiful location, the wildlife or the luxurious rooms, but the wonderful people who took care of us throughout our stay.

A big thank you to the entire team for making our time in the Mara so memorable. We would absolutely love to return, and we would 100% recommend JW Marriott Masai Mara to anyone planning a safari in the Maasai Mara. ❤️ || Words cannot begin to describe the magic of this trip, my husband and I’s first experience on safari. The JW Marriott provided the type of space that elevated an already very magical experience. From beginning to end the people overwhelmed us with kindness, hospitality and accommodation. Benjamin was our waiter for the meals and he was so kind and welcoming and brought every request. He made us feel like family. We also loved Frances in housekeeping, he was so sweet and every time we spoke with him we thoroughly enjoyed it. Anytime we returned to the rooms, they were immaculately organized and clean. We especially appreciated the way Frances had such an impeccable attention to detail and went above and beyond to meet any need.

We loved the structure of the jeeps being so open and they never felt crowded or crammed. I like how we didn’t need to stand up to get great photos. The food was delicious, every single meal. And there was also a variety each day, the veggies are so fresh! They grow a lot in their garden on site and you can really tell. The chef was very friendly and constantly checked in to make sure we were happy. He was so friendly and personable.

And finally the most enriching part of the trip were the game drives, most specifically our driver, Eric. He went above and beyond to show us all the wonders of Africa, he would position the jeep to allow us to get better photos and he knew literally everything about the animals behaviors. I asked so many questions! He never got annoyed and gave detailed explanations that were incredibly interesting. I couldn’t believe how knowledgeable he was about every species! He knew basically everything about why the animals did what they did and I found it so enriching to learn about the rhythm and daily routines of the animals. Eric was also kind, warm and very easy to talk to. He felt like a true friend at the end of the trip. My husband and I felt so lucky to have Eric as our guide and we will miss him!

Let me put it this way- during our check out, we were asked how our trip was and I immediately burst into tears describing how grateful we were for our first safari experience. I spent my entire life dreaming of going on safari and it lived up to every expectation and more. My husband and I will never forget this experience and we are so happy we chose the JW Marriott! || We loved everything about our stay at the JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge. We stayed for two nights and three days and I wish it could have been for months. Everyone there is so wonderful, kind and hospitable. Lorna was the BEST safari guide and we had so much fun with her. She made our game drives such a memorable experience (thank you!!). Benjamin was absolutely wonderful and we loved seeing him everyday. He is so nice and also knowledgeable about the wildlife surrounding the lodge. Mike was our room attendant and made everything so comfortable and welcoming. The Chef was amazing and we loved every single one of our meals. We had the best stay and I will certainly stay again whenever I am lucky enough to be back in the Masai Mara!! || Amazing Property, Exceptional Safaris, and Flawless Vegetarian Dining!
​We recently visited the JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge and cannot say enough good things about our experience. The post-monsoon weather was wonderful, and the lodge is perfectly situated—plus, flying in from the Mara airstrip was incredibly easy and convenient.
​A few special shoutouts that made our trip so memorable:
​Moses (Safari Guide): Moses is an incredible guide. We went on 6 safaris with him during our stay, and his amazingly in-depth knowledge provided us with wonderful and unique wildlife experiences.
​Chef Bhuvan Kumar: Having Chef Bhuvan at the property was fantastic. He accommodated all the dietary requirements for both the kids and adults with ease. He served us absolutely wonderful Jain and vegetarian Indian food, and even packed amazing snacks to keep us fueled during our safaris!
​Francis Kakelo: Francis was exceptional with serving our food. He was super quick, highly responsive, and always made sure our table was perfectly taken care of.
​The entire property is beautiful and in a gorgeous location. We absolutely loved our stay experience and would love to return soon. Thank you to the entire team

Address: Kenya, Narok, Kenya, East AfricaBeside Mara River, Maasai Mara National Reserve
ReviewText:
Our recent stay at Pristine was above and beyond our expectations. Every single person we encountered were simply kind and friendly. We had a river view double room, so clean and spotless, with a fishbowl like view, yet very private. The food was so good, and offered many options. I want to thank Bosco for his kindness, he has an amazing crew who seem to work together so well. A shout out to Mary, who was our beam of shining light at our meals. The surprise celebration on our last night blew us away. Pristine is a very special place. Thank you to everyone. || I recently had the pleasure of staying at Pristine Mara Bay Lodge  and it was truly a refreshing and memorable experience from start to finish.

The lodge is beautifully set in a serene environment, offering a peaceful escape surrounded by nature. The ambiance is calm and relaxing, making it an ideal destination for anyone looking to unwind and disconnect from the busy city life. The rooms were clean, comfortable and with all the essential amenities needed for a pleasant stay.
The lodge sits nest to Mara River
The staff too were very helpful and always ready to help. If you are looking for a luxury experience, look no further.
I hope to be back there soon. || BOOK IT! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
It was worth every penny! We stayed from June 5–7, and everything about our experience exceeded our expectations.
The property was absolutely beautiful, and the staff was simply amazing. A special thank you to Fridah (our host and my daughter’s friend), Mercy, Reuben, Alexander, Cynthia, Kenta (our wonderful housekeeper), Mwenda the best tour guide and Michael, the chef. Thank you for going above and beyond by preparing different meals for my little picky eaters. The generous bar tender boss I  forgot his name, the soldiers for walking us everywhere after dark. That level of care meant so much to our family. Thank you for the best celebration for my big boy’s 19th birthday.
I’m sure I’m forgetting many other incredible staff members, and I sincerely thank each of you for making our stay so memorable.
I usually give 4 stars because I believe there’s always room for improvement, but Pristine has earned a well-deserved 5 stars from me!
My family and I will definitely be back. You all made us feel like family, and we already miss you. We love you guys, see you again in a couple of years! || I booked this amazing Mara resort on my own (after getting scammed by a Nairobi safari agency which disappeared).

If you want to experience the famous Mara game drives, but don’t want to “rough it out in the tents”, this resort offers familiar 5-star luxury hotel-style rooms (fully enclosed with floor-to-ceiling windows), right along the famous Mara River.

I woke up to sounds of hippo frolicking in the river, I was well fed with made-to-order meals, and even surprised with a romantic riverside candlelight dinner, and a bush sundowner.

As I visited the resort during June before the peak safari season, I basically had the whole resort to myself.

My safari driver Lucas was amazing and kept in constant contact with his driver friends to obtain latest information about wildlife sightings, and I had to the great fortune of seeing all the big 5 animals, including the endangered rhino.

As mentioned before, I booked this resort on my own, so I contacted Helen from reservations, and she sorted out my private airport pickup from Nairobi Airport (US$270 per trip), as well as to provide food allergy information.

The nearest airstrip to the resort is Keekorok Airport (about 45 mins drive), and if you book the all-inclusive package, airstrip transfers to Keekorok is included as well.

In summary, if you want to experience a true 5-star luxury Mara safari (at a small fraction of the Ritz/JW), Pristine Mara Bay Lodge is no doubt my absolute recommendation.

I cannot repeat this enough, Pristine Mara Bay Lodge was the most wonderful safari experience for me, and please come with small USD bills to tip the absolutely amazing staff, nothing seemed too difficult for them, and they will greatly appreciate it. || The pristine mara bay lodge: I can’t express the feelings of contentment I had in this establishment. We were a group of about 24, and we thoroughly enjoyed the experience in this restful hotel. With buffet meals at three times a day, and adequate staff presence to cater to our needs, and a well mapped and maintained lodge grounds, and a safety team that takes their work seriously, our group felt nothing except for royalty. I wish to give a special regard for mark and Simon who were security, for driving me to the cabin. And a very kind word for Alexander, Solomon, and the chef Michael, who were consistent and fed us well and catered to many people including halal diets, and vegetarian. A special thanks to Fridah, for her table service beyond expectations. And an extra thanks to Cynthia, mercy, and Carol, for spending great time and welcoming us after every safari trip with fresh towels and smiling faces.

Mara Enkorok Camp was a nice accomandations right outside of Masai Mara National Park. Our tent was big and spacious, however, we stayed at three different locations with tents and here we had the most insects especially spiders in the room. So my husband had a lot to do ;) Also there is no Wifi in the room but only in the reception and the pool.
The food was amazing! We loved ever meal but one morning we ordered breakfast and it took 15min to make which we were not informed of and we had a strict time plane because our safari. However, the next day it was buffet style so maybe it was an exception.
The Masai Mara National Park was incredible! || We had a very good stay at Enkorok Mara Camp. It was pretty quiet while we were there, the staff were extremely friendly, and our room was comfortable. The only problem with the room was a fairly unpleasant drain smell from the bathroom, although thankfully you couldn't smell it in the main bedroom.

The camp has a nice pool area, and tea and snacks were available throughout the day. We also felt very safe. There were security guards around the camp, particularly after dark, and staff would regularly check that everything was okay. When we found a large spider in our room, someone came and dealt with it within a couple of minutes.

The laundry service was also excellent — reasonably priced and very fast.

Breakfast and dinner were generally good. The main reason I'm giving four stars rather than five is the packed lunches for full-day game drives. As a vegetarian, I received essentially the same lunch three days in a row — dal curry. It was perfectly edible, but some variety would have been appreciated.

My wife's final packed lunch was even stranger — French fries served with potato chips. I'm Scottish and have lived in Scotland for more than half my life. Apart from perhaps the Irish, I'm not sure anyone loves potatoes as much as we do, but even I had never encountered a meal consisting of potato served with more potato.

So, please, a little more imagination with the packed lunches! Other than that, we had a very comfortable stay and found the staff excellent. || We stayed at Enkorok for two nights in January during our Masai Mara Safari.
The camp absolutely exceeded our expectations. After the long drive from Nairobi, we were welcomed with a drink.
Honestly we didn't expect much more than an upgraded camping tent, but oh that was wrong. The tent was very spacious, stable and feels more like a bungalow. It had a huge bed with mosquito net, a sitting area and a bathroom.
The facilities of Enkorok apart from the nice garden are a swimming pool for a dip, a bonfire pit and a big restaurant.
The whole camp has that great bush / safari style, loved it.

The staff was lovely, the breakfast and dinner (buffet style) had plenty of choices and were both tasty.
Electricity doesn't get turned off at night, which is good for recharging devices.
The only downsides are very minor considering the location: the wifi only works properly in the restaurant area and the shower takes a while to get warm.
Would absolutely come back to Enkorok, this place feels so relaxing after a day of exploring Masai Mara! || It was a great experience in overall only there can be some improvements.

Positives: The meals were unforgettably good. To be clear, meals were tastier than our luxury hotels that triple price of enkorok and varieties were enough for all kinds of dietary. Staff was  very kind they are always looking to help you, even someone waits for you to escort you to the room at nights. Free water at meals.

Negatives: hot water comes from sun, it is ecofriendly but it can be all consumed after dinner, just take short shower for others, and check for the water before going naked. Lunchbox can be better. Windows at bathroom cant be closed, room is cold at nights. || Our entire family loved this stay! Well appointed, comfortable tents and very good meals. The staff was friendly- they played volleyball with us and Mercy gave great massages for kids!

This establishment does not meet the standards of a 5-star rating; at best, it might be considered a 3-star.

Significant discrepancies exist when comparing it to other 5-star accommodations in Kenya. The rooms appear worn and unclean. Furthermore, the initial rooms offer no privacy, as they feature extensive glass surfaces, allowing staff to observe guests from outside.

It is important to note that there are no amenities or shops in the vicinity of the hotel or lodge. Guests requiring groceries should purchase them well in advance of their arrival at the park. From the park to the biggest proper town is like 2 hours of dirt roads.

The rooms also lack refrigerators, which can be inconvenient. During our two-day stay, we experienced only one power outage, which was not overly disruptive.

The food provided is adequate but not exceptional. While wok dishes are available and satisfactory, the queue for them can be extensive. The majority of tourists are from Asia, with approximately 60% from China, 10% from India, 10% from other Asian countries, and the remaining percentage from various countries worldwide. || 10/10. We booked a safari package and the standard accommodation was the Rhino Camp, but we decided to upgrade to a private glass cabin in the Jambo Mara Lodge - the upgrade was around $460 ($230 pp) for two nights and although we didn’t get time to use the pool, we feel it was still well worth it for the comfort, food etc.

The food was so much better than we expected. It’s buffet style but they also have a station where they cook everything fresh so in the morning the chef does omelettes and pancakes and for dinner it changes daily with options like make your own pasta dishes, stir fry, noodles etc. They are VERY generous with the portions of meat, prawns etc and it truly is delicious.

The restaurant does look ‘traditional’ which some may feel is dated, but this didn’t bother us and the rest of the lodge is modern.

The room was spacious with a glass balcony, huge comfy bed, etc. The lodge also has a gym, pool table, table tennis etc.

The service is superb with people checking in regularly that you’re happy and everything’s good.

Overall, we would highly recommend this lodge to anyone, and it exceeded expectations. || Excellent location, but this hotel is very basic and better suited to budget travellers rather than an upscale stay. The room was not properly sealed, allowing cold air and insects inside, the hairdryer did not work, and the plastic shower curtain was dirty.

The staff were the main highlight. Leonardo and Joy were excellent, as were the breakfast egg chef and the coffee attendant, all of whom deserve recognition for their genuine hospitality.

Also, the only dinner option is buffet and it’s virtually inedible.

However, given the basic facilities and overall budget nature of the property, it is not suitable and would not choose to stay here again. || Experienced glass rooms for the first time. Good room service and hospitality experienced. Would be better if there was an intercom in the room since for every need we had to walk to the reception and get it fulfilled. Quite near to the Masai Mara National. Reserve. The overall hotel enclosure is very aesthetic and photogenic. Wifi not provided in the rooms. Available only in the reception. All day food inclusive. Disney themed kind of a hotel. Awesome experience. Highly recommended for kids and family. || The Jambo Mara Safari Lodge is located right inside the Masai Mara National Reserve thereby giving it a very unique location. You don't have to worry though as the fences are high so the animals wouldn't be able to get through.

The lodges come in a variety of sizes from small ones to large ones that can fit a family. The restaurant is excellent. They serve buffet dinner and breakfast. There's a swimming pool, a gym, a pool table, ping pong and a bar.

Address: The Mara Triangle Conservancy, Maasai Mara Game Reserve, Serena, Kenya
ReviewText:
Our stay at Mara Serena Safari Lodge was one of the highlights of our Kenya safari. The lodge is set in a spectacular location overlooking the Masai Mara, offering breathtaking views and an unforgettable atmosphere.

The staff were incredibly warm, courteous, and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Their hospitality truly stood out and added so much to our overall experience. The food was excellent, with a wide variety of delicious options at every meal.

While the room and bathroom were a little compact, they were clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The exceptional service, beautiful setting, and overall experience more than made up for the smaller room size.

If you're looking for a safari lodge with outstanding hospitality, great food, and a memorable experience in the heart of the Masai Mara, Mara Serena Safari Lodge is an excellent choice. We would happily stay here again. || Exceptional stay with my colleagues. We enjoyed the quiet, comfortable rooms, balcony mountain views, the gym, evening sauna and steam baths.
The staff always went out of their way to ensure we had a comfortable stay. Meals were always fresh and hot. The Wi-Fi was super fast. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing weekend getaway. || I have been on saf ari several times, but it took our guide Job to finally show me a leopard. His patience and persistence in tracking animals were remarkable. Over four private game
drives with my f ather , he listened to what we wanted and taught us a great deal about the Mara's wildlife and plants.

W e stayed three nights, booked by African Quest – an excellent choice. The lodge sits on a hill with views across the plains for miles: from our balcony we watched buff alo and elephants throughout the day , and the pool shares the same outlook. Rooms are stylish and well appointed, and the food was varied and delicious.

The whole team was friendly and professional, and housekeeping deserves a special mention – our room was beautifully prepared every day , with flexible cleaning times.
If quality , comfort and an authentic Mara experience matter to you, this is the place to stay . || We had an amazing stay at this resort located in the middle of the Mara park. We had elephants, buffalos and several other animals coming right in front of the rooms. And 2minutes from the hotel, you start seeing tons of animals. Amazing staff and service. Rooms are clean and tidy(watch out for lizards). Highly recommend this hotel for your Kenyan safari stay. || Fantastic stay at Mara Serena Safari Lodge! Stunning location overlooking the Masai Mara, comfortable rooms, excellent food, and wonderful wildlife experiences. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming and attentive throughout our stay. We also attended a medical conference, and the conference facilities were excellent and very well organised. Highly recommend for both safari and business travellers. Would definitely stay again.

Address: Mara North Conservancy, Mara Rianta, Kenya
ReviewText:
At the end of the day, a Safari camp is about two things: Service and Location. Royal Mara is perfect for both. Let’s start with Service. George is the new general manager and he is phenomenal! You can tell because his team is happy, works hard, and it’s all so genuine. There are so many small details to the Safari experience that the staff at Royal Mara takes very seriously. From the hot water bottle in your bed on a chilly evening, to our Masai guides, taking us down to see the hippos out of the water, to phenomenal experiences in the bush like happy hour and breakfast. Let’s talk about the food! The chef and his staff are first class. The options were plentiful and everything was positively delicious. Finally, there’s a location. Each cabin backs up to the water where at times there are a dozen hippos happily playing with their babies.  All around the camp were monkeys, dikdiks and mongoose. You will enjoy your stay at Royal Mara and make lifelong memories. || This was the best experience I have ever had on a trip.  Pictures will not do it's  justice for this place.   You need to experience it for yourself first hand. || This was the most amazing stay we have ever had. You seriously need to stay here- stop looking and book now. This is the 40th country I’ve visited across six continents and this hotel and the staff are the most amazing by far. Gilbert is the kindest person we’ve met and Simon our safari guide was fantastic. Millie also was always on top of everything and Dennis was so informative. Calvin the chef was also amazing all the food was great. Everyone else was amazing- not a single person wasn’t so smiley and kind and welcoming. They are so attentive to each and every one of your needs and go above and beyond at every moment. They make you feel like you are the only guest and the most important. The tents are huge and so comfortable and well equipped. They even had long lasting hot water and very strong wifi, which was a nice surprise considering how remote it is. There is always someone available to walk you around the property. You see the hippos in the river and hear them all night long, which is a fun experience. The safari guides are fantastic and you are just minutes away from so many animals. 100000/10 would recommend! || Looking for luxury experience in the Masai Mara North Conservancy then this is the place.
All rooms face the Mara River and you will see hippos, crocodiles and other animals coming to drink water.
If lucky you might witness a crocodile grabbing his meal from tje thirsty animals
animals
Trip made easy by
Bamba Adventures and Events Ltd || The standard of accommodation and service here is outstanding.  The rooms were spacious, very comfortable and beautifully furnished.  Tony and his staff were so hospitable and made our stay truly memorable.  Such a stunning and exciting environment right next to the river where you can see and hear the hippos and view giraffes, zebras and Impalas literally from your lodge.

Do not hesitate to book the Royal Mara, I promise you will not be disappointed.

Thank you Tony and all the staff for making us so welcome.

ResortName: Karen Blixen Camp, Mara North Conservancy, Masai Mara
Address: C13, Mara North Conservancy, Mara Rianta, Kenya
ReviewText:
Living the Spirit of “Out of Africa”

Karen Blixen Luxury Camp was perhaps one of the most memorable stays of our African safari. Inspired by Karen Blixen and the romantic era portrayed in her memoir Out of Africa and the famous movie, the camp beautifully captures the atmosphere of the early safari days of the 1910s and 1920s.

Our luxury canvas tent blended old-world safari charm with modern comfort. Even the outdoor shower behind the tent added to the feeling of living close to nature. Just across the small river from the camp, groups of hippos could often be seen resting along the riverbank, an amazing sight right outside our doorstep.

One unforgettable evening, the six of us watched “Out of Africa” in the camp’s small theater while having dinner. Watching this classic movie in the landscape associated with Karen Blixen, surrounded by good friends, made the experience particularly memorable.

The safari experience here was also different from the national parks. At sunset, we stepped out of our vehicle and enjoyed wine and snacks while watching the sun disappear over the African horizon, with a herd of elephants in the background. It was a truly magical moment.

Finally, a special thank-you to Joe and Danny. After my wife accidentally dropped her phone while we were watching a family of lions, they drove all the way back into the safari area and actually found it! Their kindness and dedication were extraordinary.

A beautiful camp, wonderful people, abundant wildlife, and a touch of Out of Africa romance made this a truly unforgettable experience. || received a very warm welcome. It was a beautiful hotel with stunning, clean rooms and wonderfully comfortable beds. The food was excellent, and the service provided by David was outstanding.

In addition, the accommodation was fantastic, offering breathtaking views from the room overlooking the water, where you could watch hippos and other wildlife in their natural habitat.

A special thank you to our wonderful guide, who took us on our safaris. Together with Leprese and Susan, they managed to find incredible wildlife for us, making the experience truly unforgettable. Seeing these amazing animals in their natural environment was very special and exceeded all our expectations. || This is the nicest and friendliest camp I have stayed at whilst in Kenya. The location is amazing, sat on the river watching the hippos and many other animals come down for a drink whilst relaxing in the camp surroundings is so relaxing.
Our safari guides Joseph and Kissimi were excellent, they know the area so well and can spot all the animals. The camp staff couldn't do more for us, so helpful and attentive. Nothing is too much for them.
The bush dinner was a wonderful experience and so was the game walk.
If you're going to choose anywhere to stay for a safari the Karen Blixen camp should be your first choice || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Absolutely Unforgettable Experience – Pure Luxury in the Heart of the Kenyan Savannah

I honestly don’t think I have ever experienced anything quite like Karen Blixen Camp. Everything about this place is simply extraordinary.

The setting is breathtaking. Imagine sitting at the camp with the hippo pool right in front of you, watching these incredible animals in their natural environment while surrounded by the beauty and sounds of the African bush. It is almost impossible to describe how special this feels.

During our stay, we experienced every kind of safari: early morning game drives, evening safaris and full-day safaris. Each one was unforgettable and allowed us to discover the magnificent wildlife and landscapes of the Maasai Mara from a different perspective.

What makes Karen Blixen Camp even more exceptional, however, is the level of service. Every single member of the staff is attentive, kind, professional and genuinely committed to making your stay perfect. You are looked after from morning until evening, while everything remains incredibly natural and relaxed.

This is pure luxury in the middle of the savannah: beautiful accommodation, outstanding service, incredible food, spectacular wildlife and an atmosphere that is simply magical.

There are places you enjoy, places you remember, and then there are places that leave you completely speechless. Karen Blixen Camp is one of those places.

Absolutely incredible. An experience of a lifetime and, without hesitation, five stars – and more if that were possible! || More than perfect for a safari! The location is right next to the park, which is absolutely stunning. They have excellent rules limiting animal sightings to only five vehicles at a time, and driving off-road is an incredible experience. In fact, you hardly need to enter the park because from the restaurant, lobby, and central area you can already see so much wildlife passing by.

The staff are exceptionally friendly! Our guides, Suzanne and Lepris, were fantastic. James, the ranger who safely escorts you to your room, was wonderful, and honestly all of the rangers are incredibly friendly. Every single staff member provided outstanding service.

Cons:

* There is a lovely little shop next to the camp with beautiful items, but unfortunately the ladies working there can be quite pushy.
* The tents can be a bit chilly, although thankfully a wonderful hot water bottle is prepared for you each evening.
* They don’t sell the amazing soap they use there. If they ever start selling it, let me know—I’ll come back just to buy some!

Overall, an unforgettable experience and a fantastic place to stay.

Address: Masai Mara National Reserve, Talek, Kenya
ReviewText:
This camp is just outside the park, the stay was very comfortable and the staff was very friendly. We stayed in a tent and it was better than expected. I rated the room 4/5 everything was fine but nothing blew my mind to give it a 5. Your there for Safari not the room. It had everything you need to be comfortable.

The service was great. 4/5 stars only because housekeeping did not provide clean towels one day and there was no explanation why. They did the bedding, gave fresh water but did not change the towels, also security walked between the tents, which is good we want to feel safe but sometimes they would be talking on the phone which diatribes sleep. Really a minor things but is the difference between 4 and 5 stars.

Location for outside the park, no complaints, beautiful place, beautiful atmosphere, nice decorations. || We stayed at Mara Leisure Camp in the King Room for 3 nights couple of months back and had an amazing experience. The rooms were big and spotless clean. The staff was highly courteous, cooperative, helped us with all ours needs and took good care of us throughout our stay with a big smile on their faces. We had running hot water in the bathroom which felt like luxury in a property right inside the park.

The food was outstanding - the chefs and the staff always made sure to go an extra mile to prepare some Indian dishes for us apart from the buffet and made sure that we had great meals every single day as per our preferences. We felt right at home and were looked after throughout our stay. The lunch/breakfast boxes were generously packed and we enjoyed all our meals in the wild.

Thank you for the amazing hospitality and would love to return in future to have this outstanding experience when I’m back in Mara❤️ || Our experience at this hotel was very disappointing. The rooms are in poor and decaying condition, and the tents/camps are moldy, dirty, and extremely dark, making it difficult to even find things inside our luggage. The bathrooms are old, worn out, and unpleasant, with a disabled bathtub and clear signs of neglect.

The food was very simple and poorly prepared, far below the standard we’ve experienced in other safari hotels. This is our second time doing safaris in Kenya, and this has been by far the worst hotel we’ve stayed in.

Another concerning detail is that the water provided in the room does not come in sealed bottles. Instead, it is served in refillable glass bottles, which raises questions about quality and hygiene. Additionally, Wi-Fi is only available in the common areas, and the staff is not particularly attentive.

Overall, the place feels run-down, neglected, and far below what one would expect from a safari experience. We would not recommend this hotel, especially given the many better options available in Kenya. || It is a fair maasai mara stay. Tented rooms are good sized. Food variety is fine and can be improved on. Tea needs to be upgraded. || Mara leisure camp is just close to Masai mara National park. Facilities are good and staff is very courteous.
Dining hall ambience is so good.
Wifi is available only in the reception area.

We stayed for three nights at this amazing place. We we were welcomed by the friendly staff that friendly hospitality stood out. No request was impossible. They did everything they could to make our stay comfortable.The rooms were lovely. Beds were comfortable and very clean. David who worked in the bar and restaurant couldn’t have done anything more to keep us happy and comfortable. Wilson Who spend time polishing our Swahili. Purity who welcomed us our first night. The chef cooked fabulous meals. The security staff who escorted us to our rooms were delightful. We would come back again. Thanks again for a lovely day to remember. || Have had 3 nights there. Friendly staff, really good food with really good waitresd and bar man. Cool always came to ask. They‘re really good in making meat. I loved seeing the elefants, giraffes or monkeys from the breakfast buffet. || Visited on a birthday weekend. The highlight was the game drives with Dee who is an amazing tour guide with the magic of knowing where the special ones were. The beds were comfortable and Edward our steward made sure the rooms were clean. Many thanks to Sammy for great meals, Alex for waiting on us and Henry our night escort. Overall a memorable holiday || We had a fantastic time at Tipilikwani Mara Camp. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. The food was delicious- 3 course meals for lunch & dinner. And exceptional staff - David who patient awaited on us during meals, Chef Sammy Who packed the perfect lunches for safaris, and Peter who ensured we safely got to our rooms each day. THANK YOU! The perfect place to stay at when you come to the Mara! || Camp is clean, also the tents are taken care of. Staff is very friendly. They always go with you during the night to protect you from wild animals. The food is delicious and you can always get enough. The river that goes by is also very nice. 5⭐️

We had an amazing stay at Loyk Mara Camp and truly enjoyed every moment. The camp was beautiful, peaceful, and gave us a real feeling of being close to nature.

The staff were incredibly warm, welcoming, and always ready to help, which made us feel at home from the moment we arrived. The service was excellent, and everyone made sure we were comfortable throughout our stay.

A special thank you to Wilson and Lankas for their kindness, hospitality, and for making our stay even more memorable. Their warmth and care really stood out and made us feel extra welcome.

The tents were clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the food was very good with plenty of variety. Waking up surrounded by nature and hearing the sounds of the wild was a special experience in itself.

The location was perfect for safari, and it made exploring Masai Mara easy and unforgettable.

Thank you to everyone at Loyk Mara Camp for making our stay so memorable. We would gladly come back and highly recommend this camp to anyone visiting Masai Mara. || It is absolutely amazing place, living in tent with luxury hotel amenities. Excellent staff, very friendly and hospitable. Great experience sleeping next to wild animals. Absolutely recommend || Lodge located in the middle of Masai Mara National Reserve. Location is great with animals walking around you in the night. We had elephants, hippos, hyenas and lions.
Ideal place for doing safaris.
Great infrastructure with a very supportive personel. They were even putting hot water heaters in the bed to make you feel warm and relaxed.
Restaurant offers very good and fresh food. All done locally.
Amazing place which I strongly recommend! || Our stay was exceptional in every way. From the warm welcome to the attentive service, the staff made us feel right at home. The food was fresh, delicious, and catered perfectly with halal options. Surrounded by the wild beauty of the Mara, it was a perfect blend of comfort and adventure, an experience we’ll always treasure. || Wonderful place, off the beaten track, in the heart of the Masai Mara park.
Location: perfect to start early morning game drive or just to sit and listen / watch animals (in the night you can hear them behind your tent :)).
Staff: from the reception through security (they walk you if needed - from 6:30 pm till 6:30 am - to protect from the animals) to the meals - everyone focus on you and your comfort
Food: delicious! 😋 and keeping in mind your dietary needs
Thank you Loyk Crew! 😊
Photos - from the game drive around

Our friends who live in Kenya booked Soroi Mara Bush Camp for our group of 10. Everything was perfection from the kind and attentive staff, the delicious food prepared by amazing chefs, the living amenities, and not to mention the game drives. Joseph (the camp manager) made us feel right at home. I would highly recommend James and Daniel as game drivers! They had great eyesight, wonderful knowledge about all the animals, and even spotted a leopard! Highly recommend staying at Soroi Mara Bush Camp! Thank you to all the staff for a once in a lifetime trip! || Our stay at Soroi Larsens Camp this Feburary was exceptional, largely thanks to the incredible team on-site. We want to extend our sincere gratitude to the managers, Daniel and Nelson, whose professionalism and attention to detail ensured every aspect of our stay was seamless. They lead with a level of hospitality that makes you feel both pampered and right at home in the Samburu wild.

The food was a standout highlight of our trip. Chef Macharia is a culinary master—every meal was expertly cooked, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. Dining by the river while watching the wildlife was made even more special by the high quality of the cuisine. We highly recommend Larsens Camp to anyone looking for a perfect blend of luxury service and top-tier dining. || This is an absolutely lovely place to stay while on safari. The service and hospitality are too notch, the food is delicious, and it's so peaceful to simply sit by the river and listen to the hippos snort and splash. If you're a photographer this is a great place to set as your base camp - they have gear to rent and a resident photographer to coach, and can take you on a day long photo safari as well. There's no pool but you won't miss having one here. || I can't say enough good things about Mara Bush Camp. I highly recommend the Bush Walk be added to your experience. Mario the guide and Peter the ranger met me after a morning game drive and we got to actually walk in the bush, seeing zebra, gazelle and birds, photographing all the tiny flowers. Mario went out of his way to show me how special the area around camp is and share his love of the Mara. The whole staff was kind, patient (I have a tendency to wander looking for birds), always helpful and friendly. The food was outstanding, the room and facility lovely, but it's the people who truly make Mara Bush Camp a place you want to go back to. || Mara Bush Camp was perfection!  Great location, amazing service and outstanding food!  Staying at the Mara Bush Camp was an excellent way to end our safari!

Beautifully set on the Mara River (thank you Carol for the smooth organization), this camp was a highlight of our safari. From our tent we watched hippos, crocs, and birds with the soothing sounds of the waterfall in the background.

Food was the best of our 15-day trip—plentiful, varied, and delicious (thanks Kelvin). Isaac’s cocktails and fresh-fruit mocktails were excellent, though wine choices did run out.

Tents were spacious, private, and well equipped with electricity, double sinks, hot showers, and comfy beds—loved the hot water bottles at night.

Game drives with Joshua Njugi were unforgettable: he found us a leopard leaping into a tree right in front of our vehicle, and lionesses with cubs. He was patient, kind and a real gentleman.

Service was warm overall, but note: a sentimental item left behind was not recovered, which raises concerns about staff trustworthiness.

A wonderful camp with top guiding, food, and setting—just keep a close eye on your belongings. || I stayed with four friends for three night at the commodious and welcoming Mara Crossing Camp in September 2025. Of our several lodges in Kenya and Tanzania, this one stands out in scenic location (looking out on waterfalls and hippo pools on the Mara River), for service (Kelvin was a wonderfully attentive waiter with a phenomenal memory, and Isaac was an outstanding and creative bartender), for food (imaginative, fresh, and beautifully served meals with mouthwatering variety, the best of our several lodges) and accommodations (a clean, spacious and comfortable tent -- with a hot water bottle tucked into our sheets for extra comfort on the chilly nights-- come on! They thought of everything!). The very friendly and accommodating staff were waiting whenever we needed to venture out in the dark, to accompany us safely to the lodge lest one of the many hippos just over the riverbank decided to wander out. Our wildlife drive guide, Joshua Njugi, was a tru pro with every aspect of his job. He taught us so much about the park and its wildlife. He was an expert spotter and was infinitely patient with us trying to see and photograph animals, especially birds! He is an extremely skilled driver and was truly dedicated to getting us to the current happenings in the park, and maneuvering his Land Cruiser so that we had the best possible vantage points. He knows the beautiful Maasi Mara like I know my own yard-- miles upon miles of back roads, short cuts, hot spots. If you can hire Joshua, do! You'll thank me.
All and all, a top-shelf camp! || There seems to be a fake account asking customers to pay accommodations fee in advance in the name of this camp. There is no warning at all in their website. Be careful. || An Unforgettable Safari Experience at Mara Crossings Camp

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Mara Crossings Camp during my safari trip in the Masai Mara National Reserve, and I cannot recommend it enough.

The camp is situated in a unique location overlooking the river, offering breath-taking views. It is also strategically located near several wildlife hotspots, making it the perfect base for game drives.

The tents are spacious and comfortable, with en-suite bathrooms and private verandas that allow you to fully immerse yourself in the natural surroundings. The furnishings and decor are tastefully done, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The camp offers a range of amenities to make your stay as comfortable as possible, including hot and cold water, charging stations for electronics, and a bar and lounge area where you can relax and unwind after a long day of game viewing.

The food at Mara Crossings Camp is simply outstanding. From traditional Kenyan dishes to international cuisine, everything was freshly prepared with the finest ingredients.

The staff at Mara Crossings Camp are exceptional. They go above and beyond to ensure that your stay is as enjoyable as possible. A special thank you to Freddie, Kelvin and Gordon.

Overall, our stay at Mara Crossings Camp exceeded all our expectations. It is the perfect place to stay if you are looking for a luxurious and authentic safari experience in the Masai Mara. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to visit the region. || This camp is our absolute favourite. We fell in love with the location right in front of the river Mara. Seeing hippos and crocodiles was amazing and we were always taken to our tent by one of the members of staff. They were all fantastic, a special thanks to Athenas at the restaurant who is such a nice person! Also, the food was delicious. Thanks for everything.

I almost feel like keeping this place a secret, because I loved it so much. But it would be a shame not to share it, as this little hotel and its team truly deserve to be discovered.
A hidden place in the Masai Mara, with just four tents and two rooms, right on the edge of the reserve, with no fences. A specially designed waterhole attracts wildlife, and what a privilege it is to watch them come to drink in the evening while you enjoy dinner: families of elephants, giraffes and warthogs. Such simple, moving moments that you never tire of. Dinners were also very good and wild breakfasts a pleasure.
But what makes this place so special, beyond its setting and the incredible proximity to wildlife, is its team: warm, welcoming, always smiling and genuinely happy to help. You feel right at home, even though you are miles away from everything.
The tents are spotless and comfortable, overlooking the vegetation and the wildlife, with lovely, comfortable beds for a good night’s sleep.
I only left two days ago, and I would already happily go back. I guess that’s the best sign that a place has truly touched you. And this one certainly has. ❤️ geraldine || Travelling with kids to the Mara?? Stay here!! 🐘🦒 We have travelled quite a bit in Kenya but this place was just perfect for a family safari trip. The house is 5 min away from the entrance from the park, and in between game drives the kids can play on the terrace while watching elephants & giraffes wandering by the waterhole in front of the house. The house was great for 2 families (or 8 adults) with 4 large rooms and 4 adjacent bathrooms. Staff is amazing and the food as well.

Unique place. Can’t recommend it enough. We’ll definitely be back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ || We had a fantastic stay at Kobe Mara. The staff were incredibly attentive, welcoming, and always ready to help. The safari guides they arranged for us were excellent—professional, knowledgeable, and truly made our safari experience unforgettable.

The food was very good, the rooms and the entire property were beautiful and comfortable, and the views were absolutely breathtaking. We had an amazing time and could not have asked for a better experience. Highly recommended! || We stayed at Kobe Mara as part of our honeymoon, which had been organized through a travel agency, and it was by far the first—and the best—accommodation of our entire trip to Kenya.

Kobe Mara is a small and truly special place. Its location, right on the edge of the Maasai Mara, makes it a unique experience. We were lucky enough to have breakfast while watching zebras and giraffes nearby—something we’ll never forget.

What really makes this place exceptional, though, is the team. Everyone made us feel so welcome with their warmth and genuine hospitality. After three nights, it honestly felt like home.

A very special mention goes to the chef—the food was absolutely incredible and some of the best we had during our stay in Kenya.

Thank you for making our honeymoon so memorable. If we ever return to Kenya, we’ll definitely stay at Kobe Mara again! || First and foremost, the staff was amazing. The place is built with a lot of thought about a natural accomodation, to give the guest the best chance to experience the Masai Mara, making guest at ease with nature and their stay.  It was very comfortable and everything was well organized and made for an excellent stay. Will recommand with any reserves.

Hidden gem!
Tucked away in Kirimatian, this campsite is so far the best river campsite we’ve been to. A campsite wrapped around by the river and wildlife.
If you think the road ends, just keep going and prepare to get through trees, branches, thorns and shrubs. 😅

Required navigation to get to as it isn’t visited much and overgrown but a hidden gem nonetheless. Quite hot at night so ensure you have ample water and good cooling methods. || The Ewaso Nyiro river is one of the only permanent sources of freshwater in the region. It acts as a vital lifeline both for wildlife and the local people and their livestock.... its a beautiful place to explore 💝💖 they're plenty of fish 🐠 || It serves as an entry to Samburu county as you leave Isiolo county. Also, it's a good location to take photos. The locals are friendly. Chilled out with Samburu herdboys || Camping prices are 5000 keynian shillings
We stayed for much less at other beautiful camp sites.cant recommend || It's only when you go down to the river to refresh yourself that you realize how beautiful this place is! To see the impressive trees with their roots that holds back the riverbanks while you refresh yourself during the heat of the day is just wow! Joseph Niyndio guides you here with his moto then leaves you alone to enjoy the nature. Ngurumani Conservancy Fees are: 1500 KES pp + 1000 KES ppn for camping. No facilities at all. No airtel signal but good internet with Safaricom although a bit unstable at the campsite itself.

Address: 22 km from Archers Post Gate Samburu National Resere, Kenya
ReviewText:
Travelling into the heart of Samburu national park is an experience in and of itself but to be lucky enough to stay at the Riverside Camp made it even better. The food was amazing, the staff were so kind and worked tirelessly to give us an amazing experience, all while surrounded by nature; the vervet monkeys were very cute and a personal highlight and to be able to look at the Milky Way while eating dinner was the cherry on top || Incredibly comfortable tents, yummy food, and proximate to amazing wildlife. During our game drive, we saw lions, cheetahs, reticulated giraffes, elephants, baboons, and more! The staff were very friendly and helpful with information about the area. Would highly recommend a stay 🙌🏼 || Dinner was exceptional, and catered very well for me as a vegetarian. One of the best nights sleep I’ve ever had. And just amazing to wake up in the Samburu! Would highly recommend. || Lovely experience, the accommodation was beautiful especially given how remote the location is. By far the nicest tent I've ever slept in!

All the staff where also so lovely and helpful! || Beautiful and peaceful camp, really nice location in the reserve - heard lions and leopard's every night! Budget tents were excellent value. The team - Wilson, Kelvin, Charlotte, and Rael - were incredible. They cooked us delicious food, taught us so much about the reserve, and went above and beyond during our stay. The guided morning drives with Wilson and Kelvin were magical - we saw heaps of wildlife, small and big. On the second morning, Kelvin and Wilson helped arrange a guided walk with the rangers which was fantastic. Thank you so much and hope to be back soon!
